Fontänen Tors fiske: Tors fiske, Thor's Fishing, the fountain
Fontänen från invigningsåret: A fountain from the opening year
Fontänen visar ögonblicket då Tor har få: The fountain captures the moment Thor has hooked the Midgard Serpent and raises his hammer, Mjölnir. Two water-spouting prehistoric lizards flank him. Wissler, by the way, wasn't impressed by Versailles: "one has no wish to see it a second time".
Fontänens entréhall har väggar målade me: The entrance hall of the Fontänen cinema has walls painted with abstract figures, and the auditorium is lined with beech panelling. The armchairs were originally upholstered in orange fabric, and there were 502 seats.
Fontänens guldgula och vita neonskylt ha: Fontänen's golden-yellow and white neon sign has shone since 1956 and won the Lysande skylt ('Brilliant Sign') award in 2016. The jury singled out the script lettering, where several lower-case letters are boldly stretched up to the height of the F.
Fordbilarna skeppades hit i delar, nerpa: Ford cars were shipped here in parts, packed in crates, because taxes and duties made it cheaper to assemble them in Sweden. The assembly hall was 150 metres long. Today the building houses offices for 1,500 people.
Fornfynden som mosaikerna bygger på är p: The archaeological finds behind the mosaics are tiny – in reality the Rinkeby goat is no bigger than a ten-krona coin. Rinkeby lies in one of the richest runestone areas around Stockholm, which is why two runestones also appear as mosaics in the central vault.
Forsån, en bit härifrån, är en liten å m: Not far from here runs Forsån, a small river with a big job. In just 1.4 kilometres it links Lake Magelungen with Lake Drevviken as part of the Tyresån lake system. It flows mostly at a gentle pace and marks the boundary between the City of Stockholm and Huddinge municipality. North of Drevviken is Orhem, a district made up mostly of countryside in the Flaten nature reserve.
Fotbollsplanen ligger på mark som förr h: The football pitch stands on land once known as Söderlingska ängen, Söderling's Meadow, after the organ builder Johan Nikolaus Söderling – the first person to suggest turning Slottsskogen into a park. Majvallen was built as a public relief-work project from 1946 and opened on 5 June 1949, at a cost of just over 327,000 kronor. Today it's where Göteborgs FF, among others, play their home games.

The football pitch lies on land once known as Söderling's Meadow, after the organ builder Johan Nikolaus Söderling, the first person to suggest that Slottsskogen should become a park. Majvallen was built as a relief works project in the 1940s and opened on 5 June 1949, at a cost of just over 327,000 kronor. Since 2009 the pitch has been artificial turf.
Fotbollsstadion Råsunda fick en smygprem: Råsunda football stadium had a low-key opening in April 1937 with a match between AIK and Malmö FF, and at the time it was Sweden's largest sports venue. King Gustaf V performed the official opening that May, at a match between Sweden and England. Råsunda was the home of the men's national team and AIK's home ground up to and including 2012. Nearby Råsunda IP sports ground had already opened back in 1910, and AIK played some of its matches there too.
Fotbollsstjärnan Lotta Schelin, med 88 m: Football star Lotta Schelin, who scored 88 goals in 185 internationals, began her career at Kållereds SK. From there she moved on to Mölnlycke and FC Göteborg before turning professional with Lyon.

Football star Lotta Schelin, who scored 88 goals in 185 internationals, began her career at Kållereds SK. Ice hockey players Magnus Kahnberg and Mikael Johansson also took their first strides on the ice at the club.
Fotö är en liten ö i Göteborgs norra skä: Fotö is a small island in Gothenburg's northern archipelago – just 0.70 square kilometres, yet home to just over six hundred year-round residents. Yew grows here; the islanders call it barlind. There's a swimming spot on the east side and a sheltered harbour on the south side. Climb up to the higher ground on a clear day and you can see all the way to Vinga.
Fotö är en riktig miniatyrvärld: 621 bof: Fotö is a whole world in miniature: 621 permanent residents share just 0.70 square kilometres. On the south side there's a sheltered harbour, and on the east side, a tempting place for a swim. The island is also known for its yew trees – called barlind in the local dialect – and on a clear day you can see all the way to Vinga, the lighthouse island, from the higher rocks.
Fram till 1658 tillhörde Backa socken No: Until 1658 the parish of Backa belonged to Norway and was caught up in several wars. So the Danes built a star-shaped fort by the river, ringed by an earth rampart and a moat. It was called Pulitz skans and later Fredrikshamns skans.
Fram till 1797 var Landsvägen en del av: Until 1797 Landsvägen was part of the main road between Stockholm and Drottningholm Palace via Bällsta Bridge. Today it's lined with urban buildings dating from around 1900 to 2014, and since autumn 2013 the Tvärbanan light rail has run along it.
Fram till 1905 var Mariatorget ett salut: Until 1905 Mariatorget was a market square with 32 stalls selling vegetables and fruit – and on certain days livestock too. In autumn 2012 the park gained four sound installations with hidden speakers, playing the sounds of earth, fire, water and air.
Fram till 1920-talet låg Hammarby sjö fy: Until the 1920s Hammarby sjö lay four metres higher than it does today. Along its shore was Sickla Park, the temperance movement's great gathering place, said to outshine Djurgården in beauty. The drained land is now home to Hammarby Sjöstad.
Fram till 1945 gick gränsen mellan Göteb: Until 1945 this was the boundary between the City of Gothenburg and the rural municipality of Västra Frölunda, and the stop was called Stadsgränsen – “City Limits”. When Frölunda became part of Gothenburg, the stop was renamed Kungssten on 30 October 1945.
Until the 1950s Bollmora was a village. Then came Lex Bollmora in 1959, a change in the law that allowed municipal housing companies to build in other municipalities. Stockholm was short of building land, and the city's companies started building here straight away.
Fram till 1960-talet var området nästan: Until the 1960s the area was almost empty. The first to arrive was IKEA, which opened its furniture store on 18 June 1965 – the second the company built in Sweden after the original store in Älmhult.
Fram till 1960-talet var trakten nästan: Until the 1960s the area was almost undeveloped. IKEA opened its store here on 18 June 1965 – the company's second in Sweden after Älmhult. The name Kungens kurva, “the King's Bend”, came from two Esso petrol stations that their owner Tore Jakobson named that way.
Fram till 1980-talet kunde man fiska krä: Until the 1980s you could catch crayfish in the lake, but then crayfish plague struck. At Hellasgården there are rocks and jetties for swimming, in winter you can take an icy dip, and when the weather allows, a skating track is ploughed on the ice.
Fram till 1981 fanns här en svängbro frå: Until 1981 there was a swing bridge here from around 1900, replaced by a higher concrete bridge. Beneath the strait runs the water main from the Norsborg waterworks to Stockholm, completed in 1904.
Fram till 1997 sändes testsignalen för f: Until 1997 the test signal for the air-raid siren, known in Sweden as Viktigt meddelande till allmänheten (Important Message to the Public), was broadcast from here, among other places. After 1998 the facility stood unused for 19 years until the Swedish Armed Forces bought it in 2017.
Fram till 2005 låg den kända skivbutiken: Until 2005 the well-known record shop Skivhugget stood in the south-east corner of the square. Since 1971 the square has also been home to Erling Torkelsen's sculpture Masterna, The Masts, a nod to the name of the area.
Fram till 2008 var Preem den dominerande: Until 2008 the oil company Preem was the main tenant. During a renovation in 2017–2018 the entrances and stairwells were given marble and new wall colours inspired by the artist Olle Bærtling.
Fram till 2014 hette stationen Vreten, e: Until 2014 the station was called Vreten, after a croft that once stood here. Once the area had been renamed Solna strand, the property owners wanted the station renamed too – and had to pay for the new signs themselves. The change became official on 18 August 2014.
Fram till 2016 låg kapplöpningsbanan Täb: Until 2016 the Täby Galopp racecourse was in Tibble. It was replaced by Bro Park, and the Täby park housing area is to be built on the site. On Attundafältet, once a car park, new housing blocks and a new town hall have gone up.
Fram till början av 1900-talet kunde man: Until the early 20th century you could reach the palace grounds from the west along the church avenue. The entrance was closed by a barrier, or bom, and so was known as Cantonbommen. The little Grindstugan lodge was built for the gatekeeper in 1846–1847.
Fram till mitten av 1600-talet kallades: Until the mid-1600s the parish was called Thorlandum, meaning Thor's Land. Today Torslanda is best known for Volvo Cars' factory, Torslandaverken.
Fram till oktober 1928 hade ingången til: Until October 1928 the entrance to Slottsskogen park had gates here. That made it a popular meeting spot, and people would say: "Let's meet at the Slottsskogen gates!"
Framför GP-huset stod länge en svartpopp: For many years a black poplar stood in front of the GP building, home of the Göteborgs-Posten newspaper, and many older Gothenburgers still remember it. It was felled in the early 1980s, but a cutting from the tree was planted at the paper’s new offices in Backa.
Framför Nidaros fanns en halvrund terras: In front of Nidaros was a semicircular terrace with ornamental cannons and two larger saluting guns pointing out over the water, while two bronzed cement deer stood by the gable. Next to it was a water-lily pond with an arched bridge. The terrace, pond and bridge are all still here.
Framför biblioteket en bit härifrån står: In front of the library nearby stand nine granite animals. This is Fredens rike, the Peaceable Kingdom, a play sculpture by Pye Engström, who lived in the area for a whole month to get to know it. The title comes from the Book of Isaiah and its vision of a kingdom of peace where former enemies live side by side. The animals are carved from black, red and grey granite, and the whole group is made for children to play on.
Framför huvudbyggnaden Sjövillan står åt: In front of the main house, Sjövillan, stand eight lime trees that continue into the park to the east. They were probably planted in the late 1700s. In the late 1800s the yellow wing gained a glazed veranda facing Lake Drevviken.
Framför höghuset anlades 2015 en stadspa: In 2015 a town park with a fountain, trees and public art was laid out in front of the tower block. It opened on 6 September 2015 during the Tyresö Festival, which is held in the area every year.
In front of the tower block, a town park with a fountain, trees and public art was laid out in 2015. It opened on 6 September 2015 during the Tyresö Festival, which is held here every year.
Framför kapellets entré ligger en damm m: In front of the chapel entrance is a pond with a little metal ship from 1979, made by the architect Lage Knape and the art blacksmith Gunnar Bengtsson. Inside is a sun cross in Carrara marble echoing the Uppland cross, a pre-Christian symbol later adopted by Christianity.
Framför stadshuset står Carl Fagerbergs: In front of the town hall stands Carl Fagerberg's 1933 sculpture group Familjelycka (Family Happiness) – a man, a woman and a small child symbolising the young town of Sundbyberg. The fountain beside it has four bronze reliefs of local industries: Marabou, the Kronan crispbread factory, the Kronan brewery and Sieverts Kabelverk cable works.
Framtiden 1 ritades av Cyrillus Johansso: Framtiden 1 was designed by Cyrillus Johansson. Its facade is of bagged brick in various shades of yellow and red, giving the impression of several houses built together. In the middle are bay-like windows and a gateway into the courtyard.
Fransk gourmet på varvet: French fine dining at the shipyard
Franz Sjöberg fick lämna ifrån sig Stora: Franz Sjöberg had to hand Stora Villan over to his creditors just two years after building it. Since the 1950s no one has lived on the 600-metre-long island all year round, and six families use the houses as holiday homes. Björnholmen still has no mains electricity.
Fred Asp och illern Göran: Fred Asp and Göran the ferret
Fredde Granbergs och Peter Settmans film: Fredde Granberg and Peter Settman's film series about Tratten and Finkel is set in Fruängen, and the TV comedy Tusenbröder was also filmed here.
Fredens rike: Fredens rike, the Kingdom of Peace
Fredrik Magnus Piper ritade 1781 en smal: In 1781 Fredrik Magnus Piper designed a slender viewing pyramid with four balconies, one facing each point of the compass. Louis Jean Desprez wanted a tall Doric column topped by Gustav Vasa instead, from which you could see the park by day and the stars by night.
Fredsforskning i kanslihuset: Peace research in the old HQ
Frescati hage vid Brunnsviken hette tidi: Frescati hage, the meadow by Brunnsviken bay, used to be called Norrbrunnshagen, after the Norra Brunn tavern. In 1897 the State Entomological Institute was built here to study insect pests on farms. Down on the shore paddles Brunnsviken Canoe Club, founded in 1909. And a little further away is Södra huset, the university's building complex, sometimes called the Blue Houses because of its sky-blue facade.
Fresk av ett slag 1519: A fresco of a battle in 1519
Fridhems kyrkogård, alldeles intill, rym: Fridhem Cemetery, right next to us, has around 5,627 Christian grave plots. It's also home to one of the Church of Sweden's three Muslim burial grounds in Gothenburg. The cemetery opened in 1968, and until 1982 a mobile church had to serve as its chapel. A little further away is the manor house Bäckebols gård.
Fridhems kyrkogård, en bit härifrån, inv: Fridhem cemetery, a short way from here, opened on 20 November 1968. For fourteen whole years a portable church had to serve as a temporary chapel, until the present chapel was consecrated by Bishop Bertil Gärtner in 1982. The cemetery covers no less than 87 hectares and holds around 5,627 grave plots.
Fridhemsplan är en av Kungsholmens stora: Fridhemsplan is one of Kungsholmen's big hubs, with the metro, buses and shops. In the 16th century, Kungsholmen was known as Munklägret, 'the Monks' Camp', after the monks who owned land here.
Friedrich Neumüller kom till Stockholm s: Friedrich Neumüller came to Stockholm aged 21 and founded Neumüller's Brewery on Södermalm. In 1861 he bought Skarpnäck for 175,000 kronor, a huge sum at the time, and under his ownership it became one of the model farms of the Södertörn area.
Frihamnen har tre pirar. Från Norra Frih: Frihamnen, the old free port, has three piers. DFDS Seaways ferries to Newcastle once sailed from Norra Frihamnspiren, while the train ferry Stena Scanrail docked at Kvillepiren on its way to Frederikshavn.
Frihamnen invigdes den 31 augusti 1922 a: Crown Prince Gustaf Adolf opened the Free Port on 31 August 1922. It started out with 1,135 metres of quay; today there are 1,937. In 1943 the City of Gothenburg took over all the shares in Göteborgs Frihamns AB, the company that ran it.
Frihamnen var förr en hamn där varor kun: Frihamnen, the Free Port, was once a harbour where goods could be stored without paying customs duty. Now a whole new district is taking shape here. In a moment we'll cross the Göta älv on Hisingsbron, a lift bridge that opened in 2021, replacing the old Götaälvbron.
Frihetens port: Frihetens port, the Gate of Freedom
Frimurarhemmet, ritat av arkitekten Ludw: Frimurarhemmet, the Freemasons' Home, designed by the architect Ludwig Peterson, is made up of eleven buildings, the first of which was ready in 1912. Elderly Freemasons and their families from all over Sweden could apply to live here, and since 2007 the buildings have belonged to a housing cooperative. Neighbouring Gångsätra, like so much of Lidingö, started out as a farm and is mentioned in writing as early as 1379.
Frimurarna ville göra om skolan: The Freemasons' plan for the school
Fritidshusområdet Kungshättan på östra d: Kungshättan, a holiday-home area on the eastern part of the island of Kungshatt, had no fewer than 87 holiday homes on 30 hectares in 2010. The island has a long history: in 1531 the Crown acquired an outlying plot here, probably then called Serszöön, from the village of Norrby on Lovön. The neighbouring island of Fågelön also lies in the eastern part of Lake Mälaren.
Fructushuset består av en lång fabriksde: The Fructus building has a long single-storey factory section stretching through the block, and a two-storey office wing set crosswise facing Ulvsundavägen. The facades are rendered white with ribbon windows. Today the building houses other businesses.
Fructushuset byggdes 1939–1940 efter rit: The Fructus building, where the soft drink Pommac was made, was built in 1939–1940 to designs by Ture Wennerholm, with white rendered walls and ribbon windows. The long, single-storey factory wing stretches through the whole block. The building is considered of great cultural and historical value, and today it houses other businesses.
The Fructus building was designed by Ture Wennerholm. A long, single-storey factory wing runs through the block, with a two-storey office building set crosswise facing Ulvsundavägen. The facades are white render with ribbon windows. Today the building houses other businesses.
Fruktodling norr om Skåne: The biggest orchard north of Skåne
Fruktträden som blev saft: The fruit trees that became juice
Fruängen blev egen stadsdel den 1 februa: Fruängen became a district in its own right on 1 February 1948, when it was split off from Västberga. Fruängen School was built between 1956 and 1960 to designs by the architect Ture Ryberg, and the City Museum has given it a green listing for its heritage value. Much earlier, around 1650, the croft of Istorp – also known as Komöte – appeared here. It's long since gone.
Fruängens station ligger 46,8 meter över: Fruängen station lies 46.8 metres above sea level, the highest point on the whole metro network. The station building opened in 1956 but was served by trams until 1964.
Fruängens station är den högst belägna i: Fruängen is the highest station on the entire metro network, at 46.8 metres above sea level. The local church, Vårfrukyrkan – the Church of Our Lady – has an unusual story. The church centre opened in 1963, but the actual sanctuary included in the original plans wasn't started until 2004, and it was finally consecrated on Advent Sunday 2005. A block away is Triangelhuset, the Triangle House, from 1955, named after its unique three-sided floor plan.
Fryshuset startade hösten 1984 i AB Stoc: Fryshuset opened in autumn 1984 in the old premises of AB Stockholms Kylhus, a cold-storage company, at Norra Hammarbyhamnen. The tireless youth leader Anders Carlberg had been asked by the YMCA in Söder to find somewhere young people on Södermalm could play basketball.
Främlingsvägen fick sitt namn 1941 och h: Främlingsvägen ('Stranger's Road') was named in 1941 and belongs to a group of names on the theme of Swedish prehistory and the Middle Ages, along with Vallfartsvägen, Härbärgesvägen and Pilgrimsvägen. The surrounding blocks, by contrast, have plant names such as Akacian, Ormbunken, Murgrönan and Buxbomen – Acacia, Fern, Ivy and Box.
Fräntorp bebyggdes under 1930-talet med: Fräntorp was built up in the 1930s with small prefabricated houses that the future owners put up together. Stone was quarried on the rocky hills of Valåsen and Källeberget from the mid-1800s to the early 1900s, and on the high ground above the motorway there are traces of ancient settlement. Folkets hus, the community hall, stands where the main house of the Fräntorp estate once was.
Från 1419 låg här Horns tegelbruk, mycke: From 1419 this was the site of Horn's brickworks, vital to Stockholm, and later tobacco was grown in the area. Bergsund's engineering works was founded in 1769, and workshops and shipyards remained the main employers until the mid-1900s.
Från 1600-talet och in på 1900-talet had: From the 17th century well into the 20th, Lindome parish had a thriving furniture industry, best known for the Lindome chair. August Werner's textile mill also stood by the Lindomeån river.
Från 1672 arrenderade hökarna Hindrik Ab: From 1672 two Stockholm hucksters, or petty traders, Hindrik Abrahamsson and Per Mickelsson, leased the land here – probably as pasture for livestock they intended to sell. When the lease was terminated in 1684 the name Hökarängen ("the hucksters' meadow") appears for the first time. The western end of Lake Drevviken was called Sjöänden, a name that later became Sköndal.
Från 1794 fanns en optisk telegraf på Gö: From 1794 an optical telegraph on the Gothic Tower sent messages to and from Stockholm Palace, with a relay station at Traneberg. The very first message was a birthday greeting to King Gustav IV Adolf.
Från 1834 var huset sjukhus under kolera: From 1834 the building served as a hospital during the cholera epidemic, and it was seven years before it was considered decontaminated. Later the sanitation department's barracks were here. After demolition plans in the 1970s, the tavern reopened in 1984, and Monica Zetterlund's park was laid out on the cleared land in 2006.
Från 1841 fanns Prins Carls uppfostrings: From 1841 this was the site of Prince Carl's institution for the upbringing of poor children. There were dormitories for 100 boys and workshops for tailors, smiths, shoemakers and carpenters.
Från 1863 gick ångslupen S/S Nackanäs me: From 1863 the steam launch S/S Nackanäs ran between Hammarby sjö and Järlasjön lake, calling at the inn's jetty. When the inn lost its licence to serve spirits in 1913 the passengers vanished, and that same late summer the launch made its last trip through the Sickla canal.
Från 1865 gick hästomnibussar mellan Möl: From 1865, horse-drawn omnibuses ran between Mölndal's Kvarnby and Gothenburg. Kalle Bergman owned the yellow omnibuses Napoleon and Delfinen (the Dolphin) and lived by Mölndalsbro – Bergmansgatan is named after him.
Från 1870-talet blev Arendal en badort d: From the 1870s Arendal became a bathing resort where merchants, shipowners and doctors had summer houses. In the 1890s a golf club and course were set up here – both among the first in Sweden. The course was ploughed up for crops during the First World War.
From the 1870s Arendal became a bathing resort. Wholesale merchants, shipowners and doctors kept summer houses here, and one salt trader's villa is said to have been built from old salt barges.
Från 1870-talet var Arendal en badort me: From the 1870s Arendal was a bathing resort, with summer houses for shipowners, wholesale merchants and an eye doctor. The salt merchant Gustav R. Setterberg is said to have built the first villa here – out of salt barges.
Från 1880-talet kom industrin till Marie: Industry arrived in Mariehäll from the 1880s. Sundbyberg's founder, Anders Petter Löfström, ran a brickworks here, and a hat factory from 1885 was Bromma's biggest business in its day. Around 1900 there was also a cigar factory and an engineering works.
Från 1881 till 1936 fanns ett tunnbinder: From 1881 to 1936 Alvik had a cooperage making containers for soap and soft soap – as well as butter tubs and slop barrels. The tower block Alviks Torn, built in 2014, stands exactly where the cooperage once was.
Från 1895 till 1994 marscherade soldater: From 1895 to 1994, soldiers marched across this barracks yard. Today the buildings are listed and house a restaurant, a market and museums. The Sports Museum, Idrottsmuseet, has more than 15,000 objects, and since 2005 it has also held the boxer Ingemar Johansson's collection of trophies. The old horse hospital has been home to a military history museum.
Från 1905 till 1970 var Järvafältet mili: From 1905 to 1970 Järvafältet was a military training area, covering 5,000 hectares at its largest. Because it was closed to the public until 1962, the old farms survived. A memorial stone tells the story of the military years.
Från 1905 var Järvafältet militärt övnin: From 1905 Järvafältet was a military training ground, and the valley lay unused for a long time. That's why it looks much as it did in the 1800s. In the southern part of the reserve runs the embankment of the once-secret Krutbanan, the 'Gunpowder Line' from the 1940s, now a bridle path.
Från 1905 var gården militär mark. Ballo: From 1905 the estate was military land. The balloon company tested the most advanced reconnaissance method of the day here – balloons – and the army kept a loft for carrier pigeons. Street names such as Ballonggatan, Telegrafgatan, Brevduvegatan and Signalistgatan recall that era.
Från 1910-talet till 1950-talet byggdes: From the 1910s to the 1950s Gröndal built leisure boats, including the well-known Pettersson boats. Today only the Skeppsmyran wooden boat society remains, restoring wooden boats in an old shipyard building protected in the local plan.
Från 1917 arrenderade Nordiska Kompaniet: From 1917 the department store Nordiska Kompaniet (NK) leased Haga Trädgård and looked after the whole of Haga Park. That same year NK built a conservatory – now Stockholm's oldest – and sent flowers to its florist's shop. The city took over in 1937.
Från 1970 gick E3/E4 längs Norra Station: From 1970 the E3/E4 ran along Norra Stationsgatan, which became a notorious bottleneck. It was meant as a temporary solution but lasted around 20 years, until the Norra länken link road opened in 1991.
Från 1970 kallade SCB tätorten Nolered,: From 1970, Statistics Sweden called the built-up area Nolered, but in 1980 it switched back to Torslanda. Today it's mostly detached and terraced houses, with plenty of beaches and lots of countryside on western Hisingen.
Från 1971 var arenan orange. Sommaren 20: From 1971 the arena was orange. In summer 2006 it was repainted silver-grey, and with coloured floodlights it can now be lit up in any colour you like.
Från 1983 hade Nacka hembygdsförening fo: From 1983 the Nacka local heritage society ran prehistoric camps here, with reed-thatched huts, blacksmithing, plant dyeing and flint knapping. Around 13,000 schoolchildren took part over the years.
Från Black Sabbath till Iggy Pop: From Black Sabbath to Iggy Pop
Från Burö färjeläge på Hälsö går Nordöle: From Burö ferry terminal on Hälsö, the Nordöleden ferry route runs out to Knippla, Hyppeln and Rörö, the outermost islands in the Kattegat. The ferries Nordö III, Ulrika and Linda serve it, and it's the only Swedish Transport Administration ferry route that calls at more than two terminals. Hälsö itself is a small island of just 1.28 square kilometres.
Från Islingeviken på Lidingö gick en ång: A steam ferry with tram tracks ran from Islingeviken on Lidingö. It carried the trams across to Ropsten and on into the city's tram network, on the Ropsten–Norrmalmstorg–Karlberg line. The ferry was in service until around 1914.
Från Kafé Höganloft till hembageri: From Kafé Höganloft to home bakery
Från Kärrtorp når man ända bort till Nac: Kärrtorp stretches all the way to Nackareservatet, the Nacka nature reserve, in Nacka municipality, so you're never far from the forest. Closer by is the Reflexen cinema, showing films since 1961, and Kärrtorpshallen, the sports hall from the early 1960s designed by Kjell Ödeen and given a green listing for its heritage value by the City Museum. Kärrtorp Park only got its current name in 2009, but in its southern part stands the old croft that gave the district its name.
Från Lilla Erstagatan leder Ersta trappo: From Lilla Erstagatan, Ersta trappor lead down towards Stigbergsparken and Folkungagatan – a broad stone staircase in three flights, named in 1968.
Från Lumabryggan går Hammarbyfärjan över: From the Luma jetty the Hammarby ferry crosses to Södermalm. In the summer months you can also catch a boat from here to Djurgården and Nybroplan.
Från Ropsten går Lidingöbanan över Lidin: From Ropsten, the Lidingöbanan line runs across the Lidingö Bridge out to Lidingö. The bridge opened in 1925, and for many years it was the only road link to the island.
Från Ryska villan till bostadsrätter: From the Russian Villa to flats
Från Slottsbacken till Gustav III:s Haga: From Slottsbacken to Gustav III's Haga
Från Stadsteatern till egen scen: From City Theatre to its own stage
Från Tappström går pendelbåten linje 89: From Tappström, commuter boat 89 runs all the way into Stockholm, to Stadshuskajen by the City Hall, with boats such as M/S Lux. Tappström, the channel that marks the boundary between the islands of Lovön and Ekerön, also has a guest harbour for visiting boats. A little further off stood the Tappsund brickworks, which opened in the late 1800s and closed down in 1959.
Från bananlager till festplats: From banana store to party venue
Från barnhem till radhus: From children’s home to terraced houses
Från bio till ungdomskafé till teater: From cinema to youth café to theatre
Från briggen Aurora till sista båten: From the brig Aurora to the last ship
Från båten ser du Saltsjöqvarn, den stor: From the boat you'll see Saltsjöqvarn, the big mill by the shipping lane. Built in 1888–1890, it kept grinding until the late 1980s and now houses flats and a hotel.
Från början av 1700-talet låg här ett da: From the early 18th century this was a labour-service croft under the Näsby manorial estate. The name comes from a gate (grind) on the road between Näsby and Tibble that marked the boundary. The croft became a pig farm in 1926 and was demolished when the new houses were built.
Från början gick färjan till Öckerö, men: The ferry originally ran to Öckerö, but in 1981 the terminal moved to Hönö. Today each ferry takes 75 cars, and the route can manage a departure every ten minutes.
Från början hade båda husen strandtomt n: Both houses originally had plots running down to the lake shore, but that link was cut when a lakeside promenade was built in the 1980s. The cowshed and stables were torn down for houses, and the granary with its pyramid roof disappeared in the early 2000s. The old root cellar is still there, though.
Från början omfattade Botaniska 37 hekta: The Botanical Garden started out with 37 hectares; today it covers 175, including parts of the Änggårdsbergen nature reserve with its arboretum. The nature park and the outer grounds have been protected since 1975.
Från den försvunna runstenen på samma hö: Only a fragment of the text survives from the lost runestone on the same hill: "... raise the stone in memory of Svarthövde ..."
Från det som kallas Högsta toppen i sten: From the spot known as Högsta toppen, the highest point in the quarry, you can see the Globe arena and the City Hall tower in Stockholm – if visibility allows and the vegetation isn't too tall.
Från epidemisjukhus till schackklubb: From isolation hospital to chess club
Från fattigvård till pianoklang: From poor relief to piano music
Från forsen i Mölndal till SKF i Gamlest: From the rapids in Mölndal to SKF in Gamlestaden: a journey through the industries that built Gothenburg. Tram 4 runs through the whole story, passing old factories that have been given a new lease of life along the way.
Från grå barack till röd kyrka: From grey hut to red church
Från hästspårväg till tågstation: From horse tram to railway station
Från industriepoken på Nynäs finns bara: Only one building survives from Nynäs's industrial era, a red two-storey house behind Anticimex. Otherwise it's old foundations and fieldstone walls that hint at the small workshops. In the city plan the area is now parkland.
Från industrispår till bomässa: From industrial railway to housing expo
Från internat till högskola: From boarding school to university college
Från kala skär till lövskog: From bare skerries to leafy woods
Från kronohemman till oljehamn: From Crown farm to oil harbour
Från landstingskontor till Hotel Gio: From county council offices to Hotel Gio
Från lyxvilla till direktörsbostad: From luxury villa to director's residence
Från malmgård till kafferosteri: From country house to coffee roastery
Från mitten av 1200-talet fram till 1658: From the mid-13th century until 1658, Frölunda and Askim were the only part of the Swedish mainland that reached the North Sea. Between 1366 and 1619 the area belonged sometimes to Sweden and sometimes to Denmark.
Från mitten av 1200-talet till 1658 var: From the mid-13th century until 1658, Frölunda and Askim were the only part of the Swedish mainland with access to the North Sea. Between 1366 and 1619 the area changed hands between Sweden and Denmark, and armies from both countries wreaked havoc here.
Från mitten av 1800-talet växte några bo: From the mid-19th century a handful of houses sprang up on the isthmus. The first was probably the croft Haganäs, which still stands and is now known as Röda caféet – the Red Café.
Från mitten av 1930-talet fram till år 2: From the mid-1930s until 2000, the Banana Pier handled all of Sweden's banana imports, brought in on purpose-built ships. The last banana boat left at the end of December 2000. Bananas still come to Gothenburg, but these days in refrigerated containers to Skandiahamnen.
Från oktober 1944 användes källarbaren i: From October 1944, the cellar bar of what was then Hotel Aston was used for Operation Stella Polaris. Here, Finnish signals intelligence staff sorted and microfilmed intelligence material that had been smuggled into Sweden. It was all burnt in 1960.
Från omkring 2015 har området vuxit till: Since around 2015 the area has grown into Jungfrusunds sjöstad, a waterside neighbourhood with some 100 new homes, a square, restaurants, shops and a sea rescue station. Jungfrusund Marina offers a guest harbour and boat storage.
Från omkring 2032 ska stationen höra til: From around 2032 the station will be on the blue line instead of the green. That goes for every station from Sockenplan to Hagsätra, and at the new Sofia station the line will split into a Nacka branch and a Hagsätra branch.
Från orgelbyggare till sockerraffinör: From organ builder to sugar refiner
Från parkering till stadsradhus: From car park to town houses
Från plastbubbla till idrottshall: From plastic bubble to sports hall
Från premiärbiograf till raggarbio: From premiere cinema to greaser hangout
Från radiotorn till studentbostad: From radio tower to student housing
Från rink till ishall: From outdoor rink to ice hall
Från scoutstuga till konferens: From scout hut to conference venue
Från sjukhus till Gula huset: From hospital to the Yellow House
Från sjukkassa till vandrarhem: From health insurance office to hostel
Från sjön rann Magelungsån söderut, unge: The Magelungsån stream once flowed south from the lake, roughly where Magelungsvägen runs today, past the crofts of Rågsved and Snösätra to Lake Magelungen. It was deepened and straightened when the lake was to be drained.
Från slingrande bäck till rakt dike: From winding stream to straight ditch
Från slutet av 1800-talet och långt in p: From the late 19th century and well into the 20th, market gardening was an important trade here. Flowers, fruit and vegetables were grown for sale in Gothenburg – at the Råda estate, Pixbo manor and close to the centre, among other places.
Från slutet av 1800-talet och under 1900: From the late 19th century and right through the 20th, Albano was an industrial area. Today it's dominated by Campus Albano, shared by Stockholm University and KTH Royal Institute of Technology, which opened in September 2023 with around 1,000 student flats. Albano is also home to Nordita, the Nordic Institute for Theoretical Physics. It was founded in 1957, with Niels Bohr among its instigators, and moved here from Copenhagen in 2006.
Från slutet av 1800-talet växte Lundby s: From the late 19th century Lundby grew fast. The reed beds along the Göta älv river were drained, and workshops moved onto the cheap riverside land. Homes followed the factories, along with schools, shops, public baths and a pharmacy.
Från slutet av 1870-talet blev Arendal e: From the late 1870s Arendal became a seaside resort where Gothenburg's wholesale merchants, shipowners and doctors kept their summer retreats. The villa of salt merchant Gustav R. Setterberg is said to have been built from salt barges, and was probably the first villa in Arendal.
Från slutet av 1920-talet hade stålgross: From the late 1920s the steel wholesaler Söderberg & Haak had its warehouse here, and its competitor Odelberg & Olson soon followed. The business wound down at the end of the 1980s, and today some 7,000 people work in the area.
Från soldathem till frikyrka: From soldiers’ home to free church
Från stentorg till trädgårdstorg: From stone square to garden square
Från storgård till ljus och luft: From closed courtyard to light and air
Från taket hänger en cirkelformad ljuskr: A circular chandelier five metres across hangs from the ceiling, with twelve clusters of six lights. All the furnishings are in pine and were designed by the church's architect, and a tall pine cross is the only decoration on the altar.
Från tennishall till mässa: From tennis hall to trade fair
Från toppen av Väsjöbacken, en bit bort,: From the top of Väsjöbacken, a short way off, on a clear day you can see central Stockholm and the Globe arena to the south – and, far to the north, the control tower at Arlanda. The ski slope has four runs and a vertical drop of 82 metres. A little further on, in the Rösjö nature reserve, Jarlabanke's stone from the late 11th century stands beside an ancient path towards Täby.
Från tornets balkonger testades sikten m: From the tower's balconies, visibility was tested towards various measuring points in the surrounding area. One sighting board, for example, stood on Ekbacken in Larsberg, about 400 metres away. Heavy loads were hoisted up the façade with an overhead crane.
Från tre gårdar till säteri: From three farms to a manor
Från träbrygga till stenpir: From wooden jetty to stone pier
Från tusen till fjortontusen studenter: From a thousand to fourteen thousand students
Från Årets kock till stjärnor: From Chef of the Year to Michelin stars
Frölunda Torg öppnade 1966 och var ett a: Frölunda Torg opened in 1966 and was one of Sweden's first big suburban shopping centres. All around is Västra Frölunda, and a few kilometres to the west the sea and the archipelago begin.
Frölunda torg ligger på Ekebäcks bys gam: Frölunda Torg stands on the old lands of Ekebäck village, with farms that went by names like Nilses, Sme'ns and Kalles – and even a fox farm. Around 1970 every one of the fifteen houses and farms was torn down except one, which still stands just east of Frölunda Kulturhus, the cultural centre.

Frölunda torg stands on the old lands of Ekebäck village, with farms nicknamed "Nilses", "Sme'ns" and "Kalles" – and even a fox farm. The village was broken up in the land reform of the 1800s. Of its fifteen houses, all but one were pulled down around 1970; the survivor stands east of the cultural centre.
Frölundaborg invigdes 12 september 1967: Frölundaborg opened on 12 September 1967 with a sensation: Västra Frölunda IF beat the Swedish national ice hockey team 4–3. The arena holds just over 6,000 spectators and is still home to Frölunda HC. Next to it runs Friidrottens väg, the Athletics Way. It used to be called Viljo Nousiainens Gångväg, after the coach who led Patrik Sjöberg, Stefan Holm and Christian Olsson to great things at Slottsskogsvallen stadium.
Frölundaborg rymmer 6 044 åskådare, och: Frölundaborg holds 6,044 spectators, 3,614 of them standing. It’s Frölunda HC’s training arena, but the ice hockey team also plays here when Scandinavium is booked and in the Champions Hockey League. The name comes from the neighbouring residential area of Frölundaborg.
Frösundatoppen var ett stort grustag som: Frösundatoppen was a large gravel pit that was filled in with excavated earth and demolition rubble – including from the Klara district, torn down in the 1960s and 70s. A memorial stone inscribed 'In memory of Klara 1600–1960' was put up here in 2005.
Fullersta gård, några minuter härifrån,: A few minutes from here is Fullersta gård, a former manor that since 2009 has been an art gallery, with a permanent exhibition that includes works by Peter Dahl and Ewert Karlsson – and a café. Even closer is Fullersta bio, where an old cinema and former Konsum co-op shops have been turned into an art gallery and theatre.
Fullt utbyggd ska Arken kombiterminal ku: Once fully built, the Arken intermodal terminal will be able to load and unload 70,000 semi-trailers a year, with ten trains a day. It will have seven tracks – 3,360 metres of rail in all – on a site covering 65,000 square metres.
Funkisbad med niokantig plaskdamm: A functionalist pool with a nine-sided paddling pool
Furulundskyrkan är lite ovanlig: den är: Furulundskyrkan is a bit out of the ordinary: it's shared between EFS, a revival movement within the Church of Sweden, and the parish of Furulund-Öjersjö. Tucked away not far from here is Prästtjärnen, a little lake that, small as it is, is a full 14 metres deep. It sits just over 108 metres above sea level and drains into the Göta älv river basin.
Furåsens kyrka ligger alldeles intill, m: Furåsen Church is right next door, and not far from here is a street with a sweet story behind it. In the 1930s, a Mrs Liljegren lived around here and baked buns that the children walking to Påvelundsskolan school just couldn't resist. She opened a hatch in the wall of her house and sold them through it, and so she became Bullegumman, the Bun Lady. Today the street carries her nickname.
Fynda på Bellevue marknad: Hunt for bargains at Bellevue market
Fynda på Kvibergs marknad: Bargain-hunting at Kvibergs marknad, the Kviberg market
Fyra atlanter bär burspråket: Four Atlases hold up the bay window
Fyra skivhus i fyra färger: Four slab blocks in four colours
Fyra vägar möts vid Bellevue i Gamlestad: Four roads meet at Bellevue in Gamlestaden: Generalgatan, Artillerigatan, Kvibergsvägen and Kortedalavägen. Around the junction you'll find kiosks, hairdressers and restaurants, and at Bellevue market people hunt for bargains among the second-hand stalls. From 1910 to 1914 the ball-bearing giant SKF had its offices at Mariedal, a landeri – one of Gothenburg's old country estates – nearby.
Fältsjukhuset skulle först ha byggts vid: The field hospital was originally going to be built at Uppsala-Ärna airfield. The beds were screened off with partitions of building board about two metres high, topped with thick black fabric. The hospital was never used and was dismantled in June 2020.
Fängelset byggdes efter en 1800-talsmode: The prison followed a 19th-century model familiar from San Quentin and Alcatraz, with open galleries between the floors that made it easy to keep watch. The ground plan is cross-shaped, and with 175 cells it was one of the larger prisons in the country.
Fängslad utan tidsgräns: Locked up with no end date
Färger som skiftar när du går: Colours that shift as you walk
Färingsö är runstenarnas land. En bit hä: Färingsö is runestone country. Not far from here, in Eneby, stands a Viking Age runestone whose carver, experts say, wasn't much of a rune artist. Still, its pattern resembles another stone, so perhaps the same man carved both. In Törnby there's a runic inscription on a reddish granite boulder set in the ground. A man named Saxe had it carved in memory of his mother – sadly, her name has been lost.
Färja till Brännö eller Styrsö: Take the ferry to Brännö or Styrsö
Färja tillbaka över älven: Take the ferry back across the river
Färjan ingår i samma biljett. Titta över: The ferry is included in the same ticket. Look across to Lindholmen, where ships were built for more than a hundred years and where Lindholmen Science Park stands today.
Färjan tar dig rakt över älven tillbaka: The ferry takes you straight across the river back to Stenpiren, where the route ends.
Färjan tar dig uppför älven förbi Eriksb: The ferry takes you up the river past Eriksberg and Lindholmen and back to Stenpiren.
Färjan Älvsnabben över älven: The Älvsnabben ferry across the river
Fässbergs kyrka ligger strax intill, och: Fässberg Church is right beside us – and between 1922 and 1976 it was actually called Mölndal Church. Fässberg has the largest population of any parish district in both the province and the county. Close by is Fässbergs Bio, a 400-seat cinema in the old secondary school's assembly hall, now converted into an events venue.
Få byggnader har bytt skepnad som Hammar: Few buildings have changed roles quite like Hammarkullen church. It was a parish church in Angered parish until it was deconsecrated in 2011 and became a preschool. Then the building was transformed once again, and today it's Hammarkullen mosque.
Fåfängan, kafé med utsikt: Fåfängan, a café with a view
Fågelbergskyrkan är byggd av rödbrunt te: Fågelbergskyrkan is built of reddish-brown brick inside and out, with a single-pitched roof. Behind the free-standing altar rises a brick pillar, and the rest of the wall is glazed from floor to ceiling. The church hall seats about ninety people.
Fågeldammen fick flytta: The duck pond had to move
Fågellivet längs Igelbäcken och i Råstas: Birdlife along the Igelbäcken stream and on Lake Råstasjön is wonderfully rich. Near Hästa farm there’s a man-made frog pond, deer are often spotted, and in the wetlands around Igelbäcken you can see trees that beavers have gnawed and felled.
Fåret är Järfällas symbol och finns i ko: The sheep is Järfälla's symbol and appears on the municipal coat of arms. In the car-free Jakobsberg centre, concrete sheep have been placed to keep traffic out. Next door is Riddarparken, whose designer won the Siena Prize in 1996.
För 2000 år sedan låg Brunnsvikens stran: Two thousand years ago the shoreline of Brunnsviken bay was about ten metres higher than today, and the Fröfjärden inlet linked the Saltsjön bay with Lake Mälaren. Where Järva krog stands today was open water. The burial grounds at Stora Frösunda farm date from the 400s BC.
För Västlänkens skull monterades delar a: To make room for the West Link rail tunnel, parts of the terminal's northern end were dismantled in 2020. They'll be put back once the new main entrance to Station Centralen is built. In the meantime, the Åkareplatsen travel centre opened south of the Central Station in 2018.
För att få en tomt skulle du ha jobbat v: To get a plot you had to have worked for the state railways, SJ, for at least five years and have at least nine years left before retirement. The land was let on a 60-year leasehold, and the houses had to be two storeys with a cellar.
För att inga stödben skulle skymma sikte: So that no supports would block the view, the roof over the main stand was hung on steel cables from two hollow pylons 53 metres high. The design was advanced for its day and drew attention abroad.
För att ta dig ner till perrongen i Hamm: To get down to the platform at Hammarkullen you ride Gothenburg's longest escalators, 24 metres high and 58 metres long. There's also an inclined lift, a kind of funicular.
Förbi Axel Dahlströms Torg med höghuset: Past Axel Dahlströms Torg with its 1956 tower block, and through 1960s Västra Frölunda with its musical street names. Frölunda Torg opened in 1966 as one of Sweden's first big suburban shopping centres.
Förbi Gamlestaden och Kviberg ut till Ko: Past Gamlestaden and Kviberg out to Kortedala, Gothenburg's first suburb, built in the 1950s.
Förbi Järntorget med fontänen som förest: Past Järntorget and its fountain depicting the world's five continents.
Förbi Linnéplatsen och Olivedalsgatan ne: Past Linnéplatsen and down Olivedalsgatan to Järntorget.
Förbi Riddarhuset från 1600-talet vid Ri: Past the 17th-century House of Nobility on Riddarhustorget, where the nobility once gathered.
Past City Hall and across Kungsholmen.
Förbi Wieselgrensplatsen med landshövdin: Past Wieselgrensplatsen, a square ringed by landshövdingehus – Gothenburg's distinctive tenements with a stone ground floor and wooden upper storeys.
Förbjudna att använda, inte att bygga: You can ban their use, not their building
Före 1972 stod här en vandringskyrka frå: Before 1972 a travelling church from 1966 stood here. It moved on and became Bjurslättskyrkan. Ingrid Danielsson's three-part tapestry has now moved to Lundby parish hall.
Före Nacka Forum fanns Skvaltan, ett pro: Before Nacka Forum there was Skvaltan, a temporary shopping centre in prefab huts from the late 1960s that lasted twenty years. Work on the new centre began with blasting into the rock in 1986.
Före Stefanskyrkan fanns ett litet träka: Before Stefanskyrkan was built, a small wooden chapel stood on the corner of Frejgatan and Tulegatan, serving the poor of a neighbourhood known as Siberia. When the church was completed in 1904, the chapel was taken apart and moved to Aspudden, where it became Sankt Sigfrid's church. It was declared a listed building in 1993.
Före USA i strålskydd: Ahead of the US on radiation shielding
Före dagens kyrka fanns en vandringskyrk: Before today's church there was a portable wooden church built from prefabricated sections. It first stood in Barkarby from 1969 while Järfälla Church was being restored, then in 1971 moved to the stable yard at Viksjö farm, where it was used until June 2005.
Före dagens kyrka fanns här en vandrings: Before today's church there was a travelling church here – a prefabricated building that could be taken apart, moved here from the Tynnered church site in 1975. The wooden bell tower has a carillon you can see from outside.
Förebilden var Centralbygningen i Köpenh: The model was Centralbygningen in Copenhagen from 1903, Europe's first collective housing block with a shared kitchen. Hemgården ran into financial trouble: the central kitchen closed in 1914 and the building went bankrupt, but it then became one of Sweden's first housing cooperatives.
Föregångaren Nackabro krog hade tidvis d: Its predecessor, Nackabro krog, at times had a bad name as a haunt for rowdies on day trips from Södermalm. In 1837 the inn was banned. The new one ended up on the north side of the strait, on land where the ban on serving drink didn't apply.
Föreningen Stockholm Sub Surfers började: The association Stockholm Sub Surfers started campaigning for a skatepark in 1985. Rålis Skatepark, under Lilla Västerbron bridge, finally opened on 3 November 2010, with several bowls and a large street section.
Företaget köpte Rudolf Diesels svenska p: The company bought Rudolf Diesel's Swedish patent and built its first workshop here in 1898. A branch line linked the factory to the entire European rail network, and engines could be loaded onto wagons right inside the factory.
Författaren Agnes von Krusenstjerna vård: The writer Agnes von Krusenstjerna was treated here for nine months in 1918. In her 1926 novel Tonys sista läroår, the heroine ends up at Solna nursing home, called the Emperor's Hotel in the book after its chief physician, Henry Marcus.
Författaren Gösta Langenfelt kallade nam: In 1944 the writer Gösta Langenfelt called the name Alléparken, 'the Avenue Park', a monstrosity – there was neither a park nor an avenue here. It later turned out, though, that an avenue really had led to the croft of Asplund, and a few of its trees are still standing. Next door are the 'English terraced houses', 43 of them, built in 1919–1920. And up on Alviksberget, Elfvinggården went up in 1939–1940: a collective housing block for single, educated women.
Förleden i Sörred tros komma från öknamn: The first part of the name Sörred is thought to come from the nickname Surv, meaning "a negligent fellow, a sloven, a good-for-nothing". The second part comes from the Old Swedish ryd, cleared land. In 1476 the name was written Sorwerith.
Förleden ”sand-” kommer av sanden och gr: The 'Sand-' at the start of the name comes from the sand and gravel of the Stockholm esker as it runs on southwards. There were several gravel pits here, including one on the northern part of what is now Skogskyrkogården cemetery.
Förr bedrevs fattigvård, sjukvård och ma: The building once housed poor relief, healthcare and a canteen, and weddings were held in the Committee Room, decorated with turtle doves. Nordiska Musikgymnasiet, a music school that moved in in 2003, was founded by the pianist Monika Kowalska and takes students from all over Europe.
Förr fanns här en lustträdgård, en kökst: There was once a pleasure garden here, along with a kitchen garden and a melon garden with an orangery. The gardener Anders Lundström ran a market garden from 1834, and in the park north of the farm part of his historic orchard has been restored.
Förr fanns två väntsalar, en för tredje: There used to be two waiting rooms, one for third class and one for first and second, with the staff flat up in the attic. The building was originally clad in red-painted boards, with white decorative surrounds framing the doors and windows.
Förr gick Göta landsväg förbi här. I dag: The old Göta highway once ran past here. Today the former assembly site, where the local court met, lies partly beneath Södertäljevägen (E4/E20), near the Hallunda interchange. The council has marked the spot with a small green space and a granite wall inscribed ‘Svartlösa Tingsplats | Alby Centrum’.
Förr gick trafiken på krokiga vägar förb: Traffic once wound along twisting roads past Tuve Church and through the village of Skändla. Once new housing estates were built, that was no longer workable, so Tuvevägen was laid out running more or less straight north. By the Skändla cairn you can still see traces of the old church road.
Förr gick vägen efter kurvorna vidare lä: After the bends, the road used to carry on along the edge of the woods in a narrow avenue to Malmvik. When the tunnel was built, that stretch was moved out onto the field, where there was room for a wider road.
Förr hanterades kol och koks i hamnbassä: The harbour basin once handled coal and coke, and later served as a container yard and salt harbour. Today it's full of private boats. Sannegårdsbron bridge crosses the harbour, with a small bascule section that opens to let sailing boats in and out.
Förr reste sig Tyskbagarbergen på platse: This is where the Tyskbagarbergen hills once rose, named after Martin Kammecker, a baker from Mecklenburg who built windmills on his land in the 1600s. One of them stood at the far end of Jungfrugatan. The hills were in the way of traffic, so a passage, Karl XV:s port, was blasted through to let Nybrogatan continue up to Valhallavägen. That's where you'll now find the monumental red-brick home of the Swedish Patent and Registration Office, designed by Ragnar Östberg.
Förr slingrade sig Ekerövägen genom skar: Ekerövägen used to snake through tight, narrow bends right here, between Tillflykten and Lindö lada. In 1994 they blasted straight through the rock instead, creating the 178-metre Lindö tunnel. The result? Fewer accidents and shorter rush-hour queues.
Förr släpptes orenat avloppsvatten ut i: Untreated sewage used to be pumped straight into Riddarfjärden and Lake Mälaren. In 1930 a major report, nicknamed the 'sewage bible', was completed. The city's first treatment plant, Ålstensverket, was finished in 1934 and treated the waste water of about 5,000 people.
Förr var Fridhemsplan en stor spårvägskn: Fridhemsplan was once a major tram hub, serving lines such as the Ängby line. Until 1968 it also had a bus terminal for the buses out to the Lake Mälaren islands. In 2017–2018 the central island was removed and a new square was laid out on the north side of Drottningholmsvägen.
Församlingshuset med kyrksal ritades av: The parish hall with its church hall was designed by Carl Alfred Danielsson-Bååk and opened in 1925. But it wasn't until 1972 that the hall was consecrated as a church, by Bishop Ingmar Ström.
Församlingshuset ritades av Hakon Ahlber: The parish hall was designed by Hakon Ahlberg in 1920s Classicism. Beneath the archway is a fresco by Jurgen Wrangel, "The Battle of Brännkyrka 1519". In the Committee Room, where weddings were held, a frieze of urns, flowers and turtle doves runs round the walls.
Först 1937 gjorde bilfabriken skäl för s: It wasn't until 1937, when Gunnar Philipson took over, that the car factory lived up to its name. As AB Svenska Bilfabriken it assembled cars from makers including DKW, Dodge and, later, Mercedes.
Först fanns bara tåget från Älvsjö. År 1: At first there was only the train from Älvsjö. In 1922 the bus operator Olof Strand and the cab owner K. I. Jansson were given permission to run a bus between Midsommarkransen and Långsjö. In 1930 Stockholm Tramways took over the route, which became line 64.
Först försökte man elda upp soporna dire: At first they tried burning the rubbish right in the chute, but when the clouds were low the smoke settled over the streets. The first chutes were square, and rubbish got stuck. The fix – round chutes with small, tight hatches – became Wallander's patent, which he handed over to HSB.
Först hette stationen bara Centralen. Re: At first the station was simply called Centralen. As early as 27 January 1958 a T was added – for tunnelbana, the metro – so that no one would confuse it with Central Station itself.
