In December 1975 Roger Palm recorded a hi-hat overdub for ‘Dancing Queen’ here. The national ice hockey team’s ‘Nu tar vi dom’ was recorded here too.
På 1980-talet byggdes sjukhuset ut kraft: In the 1980s the hospital was greatly expanded, partly because the psychiatric unit at Sankt Jörgen's Hospital was closing. Over 30 houses and a block of flats were demolished, and the new buildings, with an emergency department and operating theatres, opened in 1984 and 1988.
På 1990-talet var Bromsten ett namn blan: In the 1990s Bromsten was a name to reckon with among graffiti writers. It had one of Stockholm's legal walls at the time, a "Hall of Fame", and several of Sweden's leading graffiti artists, such as Circle, Weird, Rustle and Pure, came from here.
På 700-talet låg vattnet cirka fem meter: In the 8th century the water was about five metres higher than today, as the land had not yet risen as far. The Hundhamra hill fort was then surrounded by water on three sides, making it easy to defend. Traces of its stone wall survive on the summit.
På Arendal startade man på 1890-talet en: In the 1890s a golf club was founded at Arendal and a course laid out, both among the first in Sweden. Viktor H. Setterberg, a Gothenburg man, created an 18-hole course at Skalebackarna. During the First World War the course was ploughed up for crops.
På Askims södra kyrkogård vid kyrkan lig: The shipowners Gunnar Carlsson and Sten A. Olsson are buried in Askim's southern churchyard beside the church.
På Bal Palais har både Ella Fitzgerald,: Ella Fitzgerald, The Police and Simple Minds have all played at Bal Palais. The Cure gave their first Swedish concert here, Gyllene Tider played here on their first tour in 1980, and Lill-Babs made her debut as a professional singer here in January 1954.
På Björkängens idrottsplats, en kort pro: At the Björkängen sports ground, a short walk away, the ice hockey team Huddinge IK plays in Björkängshallen. One of the rinks used to be called Nickehallen, after the club's strongman Bengt 'Nicke' Nilsson. In the other direction, the Stuvsta estate's windmill once stood on Kvarnberget, Mill Hill – which is how the Kvarnbergsplan area got its name.
På Byfogdegatan 3 ligger Nostalgicum, et: At Byfogdegatan 3 you'll find Nostalgicum, a museum about the 1950s and 60s that opened in 2009. Its exhibition covers both everyday life and the big events of the era. At home, modern housing was going up, and industry was running at full tilt and needed workers from abroad. Out in the world, the civil rights movement was growing in the USA, the Berlin Wall went up and Hungary rose in revolt.
På Drottningholm fanns postkontor från 1: Drottningholm had a post office from 1778 to 2000, for most of that time in Kavaljershuset, the Cavaliers' House. In the 1900s the building also housed a telegraph station and telephone exchange. Today it holds ten rental flats.
På Fleminggatan 24 öppnade 1860 Grubbens: In 1860 Grubbens opened at Fleminggatan 24, an institution offering food, lodging and work to the poor and sick. It was named after the Grubb family, who had previously owned the land. In 1922 it became Sankt Eriks sjuk- och vårdhem, now S:t Erik Eye Hospital, and the street Grubbensringen keeps the old name alive.
På Floragatan 8 låg Florakyrkan, invigd: Floragatan 8 was once the site of Florakyrkan, consecrated in 1885 and demolished in 1966. Among the street's newer buildings is the former Czechoslovak embassy at number 13, built in the Brutalist style in 1970–1972.
På Hallunda tunnelbanestation, några min: At Hallunda metro station, a few minutes from here, a neon loop and Plexiglas rods glow in the dark – a 1993 work by the artist Kazuko Tamura. In the other direction, on Sankt Botvids väg, stands Botkyrka's oldest school building, the church school from 1849, still in use as an annexe to Botkyrka Free School. It's part of the old church village that was once the heart of Botkyrka parish.
På Hannebergsgatan spelades 1969 års jul: In 1969 the TV Christmas calendar Herkules Jonssons storverk (Herkules Jonsson's Great Work), starring Tage Danielsson, was filmed on Hannebergsgatan. Hanneberg is also home turf for Stephen Lindholm, who played Pelle in Vi på Saltkråkan, and the footballer Anders Limpár.
På Hästa gård hölls Stockholms stads får: Hästa farm was home to the City of Stockholm's flock of sheep, popularly known as the King's Sheep, until the city stopped keeping them. The main farmhouse was built in the 18th century.
På Ikea Kungens kurva prövades en rad ny: IKEA Kungens kurva was where a whole range of new ideas were tried out, including the play area with a ball pit by the entrance and a restaurant serving traditional Småland home cooking. 28,000 people came to the opening in 1965.
På Kafé 44 har det varit spelningar seda: Kafé 44 has hosted gigs since 1990, with acts including Kent, The Hives, Thåström and Latin Kings. The punk band Charta 77 traditionally plays its Christmas gig here on 22 December.
På Kaggeledstorget en bit härifrån står: On Kaggeledstorget, a little way from here, stands Våren, 'Spring', a bronze by Eric Grate from 1944 showing a naked woman on a granite plinth. It was installed in 1950, bought together with its sister statue Sommaren, 'Summer'. Another copy stands in Museiparken in Alingsås. The square got its name in 1946, probably after the governor Nils Kagg.
På Kikås, den höga åsen vid Stensjöns sö: On Kikås, the high ridge on the southern shore of Lake Stensjön, stands Sweden's biggest free-standing insect hotel. Not far from here is Lake Södra Långevattnet, a full 13.5 metres deep and ringed by wooded ridges. The lake has been stocked with fish, and its water flows on northwards towards Stensjön and the Mölndalsån river.
På Krällingegränd 3 ligger Järvabadet, e: At Krällingegränd 3 is Järvabadet, an outdoor pool that opened on 12 June 2020 and the following year made the shortlist for Stockholm Building of the Year. Right next door is Eggeby gård, a farm where people have lived and worked the land since the Viking Age. The Eggeby Stone, runestone U 69, also stands at the farm, and today Järva Folkets Park runs cultural activities here.
På Kvarnbacken har det funnits en väderk: There's been a windmill on Kvarnbacken since the 1780s, and it's where locals celebrate Walpurgis Night and Midsummer. On the slope lies the municipality's largest Iron Age burial ground, with around 90 visible graves, mounds and round stone settings.
På Lappis finns en tradition som kallas: Lappis, the student housing area, has a tradition known as Ångestskriket, the Scream of Angst, or the Lappis Scream. It happens on Tuesdays at 10 pm, much like the Flogsta Scream in Uppsala.
På Mariaplans östra sida låg förr biogra: The Röda sten cinema once stood on the east side of Mariaplan. Today the square is full of shops and restaurants, and trams 3 and 11 rumble past.
På Monumentholmen planterades lindalléer: On Monumentholmen, avenues of lindens were planted radiating in every direction, with open sightlines to the Gothic Tower and the Chinese Pagoda, among others. A temple to Cupid was first planned here. You can still see the foundation for the memorial temple, made of fieldstone held together with iron anchors.
På Måndalshöjden en bit härifrån ligger: Up on Måndalshöjden, not far from here, is Måndalsfortet, a fort begun in 1903. It was part of the Southern Front, which together with the Northern Front – nicknamed the Sausage Line – formed a key part of Stockholm's fixed defences until 1952. It's one of the best preserved of the forts. Closer to the stop is Trollbäckens IP, a sports ground with an ice rink, an athletics track and three football pitches.
På Nacka norra kyrkogård finns flera kän: Nacka North Cemetery has several well-known graves, including those of the accordionist Calle Jularbo, the actor Arne Källerud and the artist couple Georg and Hanna Pauli. East of the church a gas flame burns constantly at a place for meditation.
På Narvavägen 7, runt hörnet, låg först: Round the corner at Narvavägen 7 there was first the Narva cinema and then a theatre with an unlikely pair of owners: the actor Sture Lagerwall and the businessman Oscar Lindgren, who was also Haiti's consul general. They renamed it Alléteatern and put on light comedies there from 1951 to 1957. And several generations of the von Platen family lived in the building at Strandvägen 45.
På Nyängsvägen 155 bodde makarna Alva oc: Alva and Gunnar Myrdal lived at Nyängsvägen 155, in a villa Sven Markelius designed in 1937 in his trademark functionalist style. The neighbourhood has a more down-to-earth side, too: the Stora Mossen allotments were first laid out during the First World War, so that people could grow their own root vegetables through the hard war years.
På Petrus Tillaeus karta från 1733 syns: Petrus Tillaeus's map of 1733 shows no fewer than seven mills west of Observatoriekullen hill, among them Lilla and Stora Stampan. The area was rocky and dotted with small wooden houses.

Petrus Tillaeus's map of 1733 shows no fewer than seven mills west of what is now Observatoriekullen hill. When the area was laid out in straight city blocks there was no room left for them, and the mills were taken down.
På Ringön en bit härifrån ligger Vagnhal: On Ringön, a short way from here, is Vagnhallen Ringön, where Gothenburg's trams go to sleep. The first phase, with covered parking, opened at the turn of May and June 2020. There's room for about 30 trams today, and once the depot is extended it will hold about 70 more. Nearby is Hjalmar Brantingsplatsen, the main public transport hub for south-eastern Hisingen.
På Råsundavägen 45 låg en gång biografen: Råsundavägen 45 was once home to a cinema called the Savoy. In 1974 the auditorium became the Marcus Music recording studio – according to Studio Sound magazine, the first in Sweden with a 24-track tape recorder. Abba recorded most of The Album here in 1977. Today it's called Soundtrade Studios, and artists such as Robyn and Joey Tempest have recorded here over the years.
På Sandhamnsgatan står ett kontorshus fr: On Sandhamnsgatan stands a 1961 office building that was once Preem's headquarters. Between 2009 and 2011 it was turned into flats – and gained a row of terraced houses on its roof. Further on is 79&Park, designed by the Danish firm Bjarke Ingels Group, and Kampementsbadet, a municipal outdoor pool. The pool opened in 1962, and its low entrance building was designed by the city's head gardener, Holger Blom.
På Selebovägen står Trestadshusen. Malmö: On Selebovägen stand the Trestadshusen, the Three Cities Houses. Malmö, Gothenburg and Stockholm each designed a building, and all three were built in each city to find out why construction costs differed. The press mostly treated it as a race to see which city could build fastest.
På Silverdals griftegård ligger bland an: Silverdal cemetery is the resting place of, among others, the writer Harry Martinson, the opera singer Folke Jonsson and the musician Ted Gärdestad, alongside his brother, the songwriter Kenneth Gärdestad.
På Silverdals griftegård vilar författar: Silverdal Cemetery is the resting place of the author Harry Martinson, the singer Ted Gärdestad and his brother, the songwriter Kenneth Gärdestad. The opera singer Folke Jonsson is also buried here.
På Silverdals griftegård vilar inte bara: Silverdal Cemetery isn't only the resting place of the Gärdestad family. The author Harry Martinson and the opera singer Folke Jonsson are buried here too.
På Solna sjukhem var vårdpersonalen främ: At Solna Nursing Home the care staff were mainly well-trained nurses, even for the male patients; male orderlies were used only in exceptional cases. It was probably the first mental hospital in Sweden to work this way.
På Strömsberget låg en villa som familje: On Strömsberget hill stood a villa bought by the Parrow family. Mrs Parrow was an artist and the sister of Evert Taube, the much-loved Swedish troubadour. On Flemingsgatan is Villa Gunninge, once owned by the artist Filip Wahlström.
På Sundby gård en bit härifrån finns Lit: At Sundby gård, a farm a little way from here, you'll find the Lithographic Museum – the only one of its kind in Sweden, devoted entirely to the art of printing from stone. Just south of the farm, by the southern bay of Lake Orlången, is Sundbyfortet, also known as Örnnästet, the Eagle's Nest. The fort was part of Södra fronten, the Southern Front, a line of defences built around the time of the First World War to protect Stockholm from attack from the south.
På Sundbybergs torg invigdes 1934 fontän: In 1934 the fountain ‘Familjelycka’ (‘Family Happiness’) by Carl Fagerberg was unveiled on Sundbybergs torg, a symbol of the young town. The basin, known as Industribrunnen, has four bronze reliefs showing local industries: Marabou chocolate, the crispbread factory, the Kronan brewery and Sieverts cable works.
På Surbrunnsgatan ligger Norra Brunn, so: On Surbrunnsgatan is Norra Brunn, which opened as an inn in 1903 and is now a stand-up comedy club. Over the 20th century it went by several names, including Zum Alten Brunnen and Old Bowler. On the corner of Birger Jarlsgatan and Odengatan stands Sankt Georgios katedral, St George's Cathedral, built for the Catholic Apostolic Church and now Greek Orthodox. And the inn Clas på Hörnet goes back to the 1700s.
På Svartlötens tingsplats hölls ting red: Courts were already being held at the Svartlöten assembly site when Stockholm was founded in the mid-13th century. The place gave its name to the Svartlösa hundred and later to Svartlösa District Court, which was renamed Huddinge District Court in 1977.
På Södra vägen började hästdrivna spårva: Horse-drawn trams started running along Södra vägen in 1880, and it wasn't until 1902 that they went electric. The oldest stone buildings on the street, five storeys high, mostly date from 1900–1910.
På Teknologgatan en bit härifrån låg Thö: On Teknologgatan, not far from here, was Thörnströms Kök, run by Anne and Håkan Thörnström from 1997. From 2011 until it closed in 2021, it held a star in the Michelin Guide. Underground, the trams climb through the Chalmers tunnel, 1,050 metres long with a gradient of 24 per mille.
På Torshamnsgatan 21–23 ligger Isafjord: At Torshamnsgatan 21–23 is Isafjord 1, the block that houses Ericsson's headquarters. The office complex, designed by Wingårdh Architects, was nominated for Stockholm Building of the Year 2013. A stone's throw away is Kistamässan, the Kista exhibition centre, which opened in September 2008 and was built together with the hotel skyscraper Victoria Tower.
På Trädgårns scen har bland andra Nation: Trädgårn’s stage has hosted the likes of Nationalteatern, Magnus and Brasse, Lill-Babs and Charlie Norman – but also Alice Cooper and Dimmu Borgir. One of its biggest hits with audiences was Kabaré Kumlin in 1987, starring the comedy group After Shave and Anders Eriksson.
På Tunberget en bit bort står Tunbergsre: On Tunberget hill, not far away, stands the Tunberg reservoir, a water tower completed in 1973 that holds 25,000 cubic metres of drinking water. Closer by is the Häggvik tunnel, opened in 1998 and the shortest of the three tunnels on the Norrortsleden road. It's just 289 metres long, and there's a park on its roof.
På U 44 står att Östen och Frösten reste: U 44 records that Östen and Frösten raised the stone in memory of their father Este, and that Äsgärd raised it in memory of her husband. The inscription ends simply: ‘but Snare carved’. The pieced-together stone is missing only a bit of its top.
På Vasagatan 7 låg krogen Tre Remmare, m: Vasagatan 7 was once home to Tre Remmare, a restaurant with a casino and nightclub on the same premises. It was one of the few places in Stockholm allowed to stay open until five in the morning, and it became notorious for drunkenness and drugs. It lost its licence and closed in 2007, and the Bishops Arms pub has been there since. Across the street stands the World Trade Center, designed by Ralph Erskine.
På Vårbyhuset, nära fyndplatsen, hänger: On the Vårby building, near where the hoard was found, hangs the ceramicist Mari Pårup's relief Vårbyskatter (Vårby Treasures) from 2008. More than a hundred glazed hemispheres form a gigantic necklace across the brick wall. The largest bead is about 50 centimetres across.
På altaret stod ett litet krucifix i sil: On the altar stood a small silver crucifix with a flower of blue glass, designed by the silversmith Sigurd Persson. The octagonal oak font dated from 1950.
På altaret står ett bysantinskt kors var: On the altar stands a Byzantine cross whose base is made from floorboards from Danderyd church. The wooden altarpiece, showing the risen Christ, was made by Sister Lydia of the Daughters of Mary at Vallby church.
På bergets sydsluttning finns ett klappe: On the southern slope of the hill is a field of rounded beach cobbles, with old shoreline ridges and stone pavements – considered the main sight on Hummelmoraberget. Higher up grows pine forest on bare rock, carpeted with reindeer lichen and mosses.
På bottenvåningen låg Fornboda Conditori: The ground floor was home to Fornboda Conditori & Café, which in 1937 changed its name to Astrea after the neighbouring block. In 1992 Konditori Princess moved into the same premises.
På brons fyra granitkolonner står fornno: On the bridge's four granite columns stand Norse gods by Rolf Adlersparre: Heimdall with the Gjallarhorn and Frigg with her staff to the north, Freya with a falcon and Thor with his hammer Mjölnir to the south. The inspiration came from Viktor Rydberg's Fädernas gudasaga, his retelling of the Norse myths.
På de första 240 lotterna byggdes ”Skarp: On the first 240 allotments, the "Skarpnäck cottage" was built – a functionalist cottage in two models. The allotment holders put them together themselves from standard plans drawn up by the City of Stockholm.
På de två övre planen går norrgående grö: On the upper of the two levels, northbound green line trains and southbound red line trains run from the same platform, and the other way round on the level below. That means you can change between the red and green lines in opposite directions just by crossing the platform.
På den ofullbordade U 81 går bara ett or: On the unfinished U 81, only one word can be read: the man's name Ärnmund at the start of the runic band. The lines are shallow and hard to make out. Both rock slabs lie in a burial ground with a mound and thirteen stone settings.
På den ofullbordade hällen U 81 går bara: On the unfinished rock carving U 81 just one word can be read: the man's name Ärnmund, at the start of the runic band. The lines are so shallow they're hard to make out.
På en 45 meter hög bergknalle, en kort p: On a rocky knoll 45 metres high, a short walk from here, stood Skärholmen's hillfort, dating from the Migration Period and the Viking Age. It was a strategic spot, close to the ancient shipping route to Helgö and Birka. The rock falls steeply towards Lake Mälaren, and on the gentler inland side you can still see the remains of a wall made of huge boulders piled one on top of another.
På en av Äppelvikens högsta punkter, ett: On one of the highest points in Äppelviken, close by, Västerled Church looks out over villas from the 1920s and 1930s. Stora mossen is part of the Old Bromma garden city, and almost two thirds of its homes are villas. Nearby Bromma Upper Secondary School is a World Heritage school, working with its nearest World Heritage Site, Drottningholm Palace.
På en berghäll i Skylsta, en bit härifrå: On a slab of rock at Skylsta, not far from here, is a Viking Age runic inscription, 1.7 metres long and 0.85 metres wide, with runes six centimetres high. According to Richard Dybeck, there was also a fragment of a runestone on the same hill, but no one has ever found it again. A little runic mystery at the edge of the forest.
På en berghäll vid Drottningholmsvägen f: On a rock slab beside Drottningholmsvägen are two rune carvings from the 11th century. They were found by chance in 1904 by someone out picking berries. For centuries they'd lain under soil and moss, which is why they're still in such good condition. One of them tells us that Sigvid and Sigrev had the stone carved in memory of their father, Sinar.
På en häll i gravfältet finns en sentida: On a rock in the burial ground is a recent carving of a human figure and the letters IOGT. It's linked to Björklundstorpet, a croft that for a while served as the meeting hall of a temperance order. The croft was torn down in the 1950s, but the steps up from Bällstavägen show where it stood.
På en höjd med utsikt över Säveåns dalgå: On a hill above the Säveån river valley stands Partille herrgård, Partille Manor, known locally as ‘the Castle’. It's a short way from here, about 200 metres west of Partille Church, and you get there via Carl Wilhelm Carlbergs Allé. The manor has been a listed building since December 1995.
På en karta över Djurgården från 1696 st: A 1696 map of Djurgården marks nothing here but ‘Lada’ – a barn. Later the site was home to one of the huntsmen of the royal hunts. The house was built in 1820, but when the Djurgårdsbrunn Canal was to be dug in the 1830s, King Karl XIV Johan bought the property back.
På en kulle alldeles intill står Burås k: On a hill right next to us stands Burås kvarn, a three-storey windmill built in 1892–1893 by the master builder Emanuel Andréasson. The wind has been hard at work here for a long time – there have been windmills on this spot since the 18th century. Listed since 2004, the mill is a landmark in south-western Kungälv municipality.
På en liten kulle i kvarteret Grimhild s: On a little hill in the Grimhild block stands the Ekeby water tower, designed by Axel Bergman and built in 1908. Its tank was drained in 1965, and since 1995 the tower has been a private home – quite an unusual address. Below it is Lake Ekebysjön, just three metres deep, in the middle of a nature reserve with wooded meadows and black alder swamp forest.
På en numera skogbeväxt kulle, kallad Kv: On a hill now covered in trees, known as Kvarnbacken – Mill Hill – there once stood two windmills with wonderful names: Stora Stampan, the Big Stamp, and Holländskan, the Dutch Lady. Together they were known as the Rinkeby mills, after the village of Rinkeby in Spånga parish, on whose land they stood. Only the western one, Stora Stampan, is still standing today, just a couple of minutes' walk from here.
På en trädbevuxen kulle söder om Ekerövä: On a wooded hill south of Ekerövägen is the Wallenberg family's resting place. Their mausoleum has become a landmark for the whole area. Lindö, incidentally, was once an island of its own, but as the land has risen it has grown and joined up with Lovön. At Tappström, bricks were fired at the Tappsund brickworks right up until 1959.
På ett hustak i Råcksta centrum lyser en: On a rooftop in Råcksta centre glows a neon sign from the 1950s, with RÅCKSTA in green and a jaunty 'Centrum' in yellow. It was restored in 2011 and shines as brightly as ever. The nearby metro depot was originally called Spångahallen, because Vällingby belonged to Spånga municipality, which had joined Stockholm only a few years earlier. And Råcksta cemetery has around 30,000 urn graves.
På frågan varför parkens byggnader var r: Asked why the park's buildings were pink, the founder Herman Lindholm replied: "Because the best dessert I know is lingonberries and milk." In fact, the architects had chosen the colour for the Jubilee Exhibition.
På gamla vykort heter huset Kafé Höganlo: On old postcards the building is called Kafé Höganloft; it housed a café and restaurant until the 1940s. When the Home Guard took over in 1945, Hemvärnsgårdens Konditori och Hembageri – a café and home bakery – ran on the ground floor, and the Viking Hall was hired out for weddings and dinners.
På gammal jordbruksmark byggde HSB och R: On old farmland, the housing associations HSB and Riksbyggen built some 3,000 homes from 1971 onwards around Kärra Centrum, which opened on 29 November 1978. Kärra school is much older, built as an elementary school in 1874.
På grund av landhöjningen växer Gråviken: Because the land is slowly rising, Gråviken inlet is gradually silting up. In the 1720s its mouth was about 90 metres wide – today it's around 40 metres and only a metre deep.
På gula spåret klättrar du upp på Källto: The yellow trail climbs Källtorpsberget, 66 metres above sea level, with views towards the Globe arena and Hammarbybacken ski slope. Grey tree skeletons from the fire of August 1999 are still visible.
På höjden alldeles i närheten fanns unde: On the hill just nearby, during Sweden's wartime state of readiness from 1939 to 1945, was the Skanskvarn anti-aircraft battery, complete with firing trenches, gun pits and tank traps. Its job was to protect three bridges – Skansbron, Skanstullsbron and the vital Årstabron railway bridge – and if the defences had given way, the plan was to blow up Årstabron before the enemy could use it. Below the hill is an allotment garden that dates all the way back to 1917, when it was set up as Koloniföreningen Stugan.
På innergården står klockstapeln, ett hö: The bell tower in the inner courtyard is a tall Cor-Ten steel cross whose four arms point to the four points of the compass. The bells you hear actually come from loudspeakers.
In the courtyard stands the bell tower: a tall cross of Corten steel whose four arms point to the four points of the compass. There's no actual bell – the ringing comes from loudspeakers.
På kajen står Lumakranen, en stor portal: On the quay stands the Luma crane, a large portal crane preserved from the days when this was a working harbour. At its peak, in 1950, Stockholm had 148 harbour cranes.
På kartan redan 1703: On the map as early as 1703
På kartografen Abraham Hesselgrens karta: On the cartographer Abraham Hesselgren's 1703 map of Vårby, the croft appears as "Måns kierr", just south of what was then the new highway. It came with both fields and meadows on either side of the road.
På kyrkogården finns en gravhäll över Ol: The churchyard holds a grave slab for Olof Claeson, chief inspector at the Klippan customs station, inscribed Anno 1728. It once lay in the chancel of the old church. The oldest gravestones, from 1680 and 1729, stand lined up along the north wall.
På kyrkogården ligger en gravhäll över O: The churchyard holds a grave slab for Olof Claeson, chief inspector at the Klippan customs station. It bears the inscription "Anno 1728" and once lay in the chancel of the old church. The oldest gravestones now stand lined up along the north wall.
På kyrkogården står ett monument över sk: In the churchyard stands a monument to the poet Olof von Dalin and the mathematician Samuel Klingenstierna, who both taught Gustav III. The obelisk of Kolmården marble with a gilded star was designed by Jean Eric Rehn and paid for by the king's mother, Lovisa Ulrika. The architect Ralph Erskine is also buried here.
På medeltiden var Blockhusudden en ö, he: In the Middle Ages Blockhusudden was an island, entirely surrounded by water. The strait ran roughly where the Thiel Gallery's car park is today. Post-glacial land uplift then turned the islet into a headland.
På nordöstra Lidingö, norr om Hustegafjä: On north-eastern Lidingö, north of the Hustegafjärden bay, is the little village of Furutorp. Nearby you'll find Långnäs gård, a privately owned farm that grew out of a larger farmstead from the mid-14th century, and the Sjövik housing area, on a strip of shoreline along Kyrkviken bay that was left out of the Långängen-Elfvik nature reserve.
På området står den så kallade Ascheberg: On the grounds stands the Ascheberg Oak, named after Gustaf Adolf von Ascheberg, who is said to have held his wedding dinner beneath it. Parts of the surrounding oak woodland have survived as well.
På platsen finns i dag kraftigt överväxt: All that remains on the site today are heavily overgrown house foundations, a collapsed root cellar and a short embankment from the old driveway. The name lives on in Lindvretensvägen and in the E4/E20 interchange.
På predikstolen från 1600-talet sitter e: The 17th-century pulpit carries an even older hourglass with four glasses. In the church porch there's an iron-bound poor box from the 1700s, and a votive ship from 1801 hangs in the nave.
På runsvenska lyder texten: \"Sigviðr ok: In runic Swedish the text reads: ‘Sigviðr ok Sigræifʀ letu rista stæin þennsa æftiʀ Sinar, faður sinn’ – Sigvid and Sigröd had this stone carved in memory of Sinar, their father. The rock lies on a ridge and bears two carvings, U 58 and U 59.
På skolans huvudbyggnad sitter reliefen: The school's main building bears the relief Noah's Ark by the artist Allan Wallberg. The school was built in 1952–1953 for just over 300 pupils in 21 classes, and the City Museum has marked it green for its cultural value.
På slottsområdet står en stuga som har v: In the palace grounds stands a cottage that has been to a World's Fair! The Ornäs cottage is a slightly smaller copy of the original in Ornäs in Dalarna. It was shown at the 1867 World's Fair in Paris and has stood here since 1869. The neighbourhood also has villas with funny names, such as Villa Snörin – pronounced 'snör-in'.
På sommaren går kungens får och betar på: In summer the King's sheep graze on Svanholmen, so the islet is only open to the public in winter.
På takblocket finns ett tiotal inhuggna: The capstone bears about ten carved cup marks, known in Swedish as älvkvarnar or "elf mills", which were used for offerings. After excavation, the dolmen was rebuilt in 1979 about ten metres further east on the same slope.
På tomten låg ett ålderdomshem från 1888: An old people's home from 1888 stood on this site, though it mostly served as a poorhouse. In 1912 an isolation hospital for tuberculosis and typhoid was also built here; it later became Lidingö's first town hall, with a clock tower on the roof.
På torget stod från 2000 statyn KattFlic: From 2000 the square was home to the statue KattFlickaFjäril (CatGirlButterfly) by the artist Petra Borén. When new flats were built on the square in 2011–2012 it was moved, and since 2012 it has stood beside a path past the former square.
På torget står Vesslan, en fontänskulptu: On the square stands Vesslan, the Weasel, a fountain sculpture by Otto Strandman from 1912. A naked young man in bronze has just spotted a weasel, which is hiding in a little cave at the very bottom of the sculpture, and there's a drinking fountain on either side. Round the corner, at Scheelegatan 8, was the restaurant L'Escargot – in 1984 it became one of the first four restaurants in Sweden to win a Michelin star.
På torghallens fasad finns en lång väggm: The front of the market hall has a long mural by Jan Persson showing scenes from Mikhail Bulgakov's novel The Master and Margarita. It was painted during a renovation in 1995.
A long mural by Jan Persson stretches across the front of the market hall. It shows scenes from Mikhail Bulgakov's novel The Master and Margarita and was painted during a renovation in 1995.
På tunnelbanestationen finns konstverket: At the metro station you'll find the artwork Linear, a huge folding ruler by the Danish artist Freddy Fraek from 1983.
På tunnelbanestationen står ett exemplar: In the metro station you'll find a copy of Carl Fredrik Reuterswärd's sculpture The Knotted Gun – the best-known version stands outside the UN headquarters in New York. A couple of hundred metres away is Fittja gård, an old farm whose inn was one of Sweden's biggest coaching inns in the 1600s and 1700s. One of its buildings served as the district courthouse right up until 1916. Today the farm is home to Mångkulturellt centrum, the Multicultural Centre.
På verkstadsskolan i Spånga utbildades m: The vocational school in Spånga trained engine operators and mechanics, and the engines the students built were used in motor races at Solvalla.
På vikingatiden låg Fröfjärden här, med: In the Viking Age the Fröfjärden inlet lay here, linked to Lake Mälaren via Ulvsundasjön. The lake is named after the vanished Crown farm of Långlöt, and the parks around it were laid out in 1947–1962 to designs by Sven A. Hermelin.
På vintrarna plogas ofta ett skridskospå: In winter a skating track is often cleared on Källtorpssjön lake, and you can hire skates and skis at the farm. There's also a sauna and cold-water bathing.
På Åsögatan 195 hade Albert Engström sin: At Åsögatan 195, the artist and writer Albert Engström had his 'wigwam' – and he even entered his invented character Kolingen in the population register there. Before him, Carl Larsson had a studio at the same address, as did the artists' group De tre.
Påvelundsstugan användes som skollokal å: Påvelundsstugan was used as a schoolroom from 1849 to 1867. Today it belongs to the City of Gothenburg and is used by the Västra Frölunda local history society.
Racermotorer från verkstadsskolan: Racing engines from the trade school
Radhus och villor präglar Kälvesta, en s: Kälvesta, a district of terraced houses and villas, sits in the north-western corner of Hässelby-Vällingby, a bit like a border guard. To the north is Skälby in Järfälla municipality, to the west Hässelby Villastad, and to the south-west Vinsta. Vinsta, incidentally, takes its name from an old village and only became a district in 1953.
Radhusbyn Atlantisområdet byggdes 1952–1: The terraced houses of the Atlantis area were built between 1952 and 1955 to designs by Bertil Karlén, Jon Höjer and Sture Ljungqvist, and they attracted attention from abroad. From 1968 to 1983, one of them was home to Lisbeth and Olof Palme – the future prime minister – and their three sons. Today the City Museum has given the houses its highest heritage rating for their exceptional historical value.
Radhusen i Mursmäckan är bara 6,55 meter: The terraced houses in Mursmäckan are only 6.55 metres wide, built to fit precisely within the rules for a two-storey house with an attic. They present a closed face to the street, but open up with patios towards the courtyard.
Radhusen i kvarteret Tegen: The terraced houses in the Tegen block
Radhusområdet Hersby Åker byggdes 1949–1: The terraced-house area of Hersby Åker was built in 1949–1955 to designs by Holger Blom: thirteen rows of terraced houses with 115 homes in all, a fine example of the architecture of the Swedish folkhem, the post-war 'people's home' welfare state. Nearby, on a small hill, stands the Hersby farm storehouse, a listed building that once belonged to Hersby gård, one of Lidingö's traditional main farms.
Radiostation blev idrottsplats: From radio station to sports ground
Radiostation på idrottsplatsen: A radio station on the sports ground
Radiotorget byggdes 1953 efter amerikans: Radiotorget was built in 1953 as a satellite square on the American model – a new way of building squares outside the city centre, and one of the first of its kind in Europe. The architects were Sven Brolid and Jan Wallinder.
Radiotorget i närheten var något helt ny: Radiotorget, nearby, was something completely new when it opened in 1954. It was a “satellite square” – a shopping square outside the city centre, on the American model – the first of its kind in Sweden and one of the first in Europe. It was spruced up in 2019–20 and still has several small shops.
Radiotorget ritades av Sven Brolid och J: Radiotorget was designed by Sven Brolid and Jan Wallinder and was one of the first satellite-town squares in Europe. When it was refurbished in 2019–2020, three new buildings with flats and shops were added.
Radiotorget rustades upp 2019–2020. Då b: Radiotorget was given a makeover in 2019–2020, when three new buildings went up alongside it: two taller blocks of flats and a lower two-storey building with shops at street level.
Radiotorget är ett torg med blandade små: Radiotorget is a square with a mix of small shops: an upholsterer's workshop, a hair salon, a dog groomer, a photo shop, a sports shop, a fishmonger and a tobacconist.
Radiotorget, några hundra meter bort, in: Radiotorget, a few hundred metres away, opened in 1954 as Sweden's first satellite town square – a shopping centre on the American model. Further on is the Högsbo pegmatite quarry, where feldspar, quartz, mica and beryl were mined from 1945 until the late 1950s. Rare minerals such as monazite and bismuthinite have also turned up there.
Radium som hälsoreklam: Radium as a health selling point
Ragnar Liljenroth anlitade arkitekten Fr: Ragnar Liljenroth, a director in the match industry, hired the architect Francois Priffé, who designed a castle-like two-storey manor with a hipped mansard roof, inspired by the 18th century. The style mixes Art Nouveau with National Romanticism.
Ragnälv lät göra en bro efter sin ende s: Ragnälv had a bridge built in memory of her only son, Anund. The inscription asks God to help his soul 'better than he deserved'. On the back of the stone is a cross with eight identical arms.
Rakt fram ligger Gröna Lund, Sveriges äl: Straight ahead is Gröna Lund, Sweden's oldest amusement park.
Rakt fram ligger Skansen Lejonet, en för: Straight ahead is Skansen Lejonet, the Lion Fort – a 17th-century stronghold topped with a gilded lion.
Rakt fram ser du den röd-vita skyskrapan: Straight ahead is the red-and-white skyscraper that Gothenburgers call the Lipstick.
Rakt under Östasiatiska museet finns ett: Right beneath the Museum of Far Eastern Antiquities is a rock shelter, blasted out in the early 1940s for the naval commander and his staff to use in wartime. Today it's home to Stockholm Toy Museum, full of toys and comics. Next to it is Högvakten, the Main Guard building from 1777, and the former Skeppsholmen Church, now the Eric Ericsonhallen concert hall, with a seven-metre tapestry called Havets sång, Song of the Sea.

Directly beneath the Museum of Far Eastern Antiquities is a rock chamber blasted out in the early 1940s for the naval commander and his staff in wartime. Today it's home to the Stockholm Toy Museum, full of toys and comics. Next door is Högvakten, the old guardhouse built in 1777, and the former Skeppsholmen Church, which since 2009 has been the Eric Ericson Hall concert venue.
Ralph Erskine bodde själv på Lovön och v: Ralph Erskine lived on Lovön island himself and wanted to create a 'Mälaren town' at Tappström. Of all his work, this was the area he was happiest with, saying in 2006: 'I like to go there myself to shop and walk around.'
Ralph Erskine gjorde sina första skisser: Ralph Erskine made his first sketches for the Law Faculty building as early as 1986. One proposal was to put it where the university library stands today.
Ralph Erskines tanke var att skapa en \": Ralph Erskine's vision was to create a "Mälaren town" at Tappström. The centre and housing area were built in stages from 1983 to 1991, with shops, terraced houses and apartment blocks. The area has attracted international attention.
Rambergsvallen byggdes som statskommunal: Rambergsvallen was built as a state-and-municipal relief work project and opened on 18 August 1935. It got its final look when the north stand went up in 1979 and the main stand in 1983. The attendance record stands at 8,379.
Rambergsvallen invigdes 1935 som statsko: Rambergsvallen opened in 1935, built as a state-and-municipal job-creation project. Häcken played top-flight Allsvenskan football here on special dispensation, as the ground didn't meet the association's standards. The attendance record was 8,379.
Rampen som bara bussar får ta: The ramp only buses may use
Rannebergen Centrum byggdes 1974 och har: Rannebergen Centrum was built in 1974 and has its own swimming pool, and across the street the Bohusleden trail and the Vättlefjäll hills are waiting, with lovely lakes for swimming and fishing. Nearby is the start of the Lärjeån valley nature reserve, protected in 2026 and covering more than 1,100 hectares.
Rannebergen ligger högt och nära naturen: Rannebergen sits high up, close to nature. Just a few minutes away is Idtjärnet, a forest lake 109 metres above sea level, and a little further on is Lake Stora Mölnesjön, with a swimming spot and a jetty. The centre itself, with a swimming pool and a pizzeria, was built in 1974, and the Bohusleden trail and the Vättlefjäll hills are right on its doorstep.
Raoul Wallenbergs far dog i cancer i maj: Raoul Wallenberg’s father died of cancer in May 1912, aged just 24. On 4 August that year Raoul was born in his mother’s bedroom at Kappsta, and the family spent their summers here until the late 1920s.
Rapparen V, Victor Hollender, startade 2: In 2010 the rapper V, Victor Hollender, launched the website Mariaplan.com to spread hip hop from Gothenburg, with Majorna as its home base.
Receptet på Club soda hämtade grundaren: The founder, Torsten Ax:son Johnson, probably brought the Club soda recipe back from Ireland. The factory closed in 1945, but the brand lived on with Apotekarnes, Pripps and Carlsberg, and wasn't dropped until 2006. At the spring today there's a hand pump that gives salty water.
Redaktören som grävde en damm: The editor who dug a pond
Redan 1422 kallades västligaste Södermal: As early as 1422 the western tip of Södermalm was called Horn, probably after the pointed western headland of Åsön. When the customs post came here in the 17th century, along with the pontoon bridge to Liljeholmen, it became Horns tull, Horn's toll gate. The name lived on even after the tolls were abolished in 1810.
Redan 1624 ville stadens styrande ha en: As early as 1624 the city's leaders wanted a canal from the Mölndalsån river to the harbour, but King Gustav II Adolf said no – there was no money. Work finally began in 1640, with the canal dug by fortification troops and town soldiers.
Redan 1641 startade holländaren Johan va: As early as 1641 the Dutchman Johan van Swindern set up a pitch works here, in the valley between Finnberget and Finnbodaberget. People at the time described it as 'et stådtliget werk' – a splendid works – with 'Trenne beckpannor', three pitch pans.
Redan 1690 byggdes en träbro här, vid Bä: A wooden bridge was built here as early as 1690, at the narrowest point of Bällstaviken bay. It was a link on the road to Drottningholm Palace, via a ferry landing at Tyska botten. Today's bridge dates from 1936 and was widened in 1958.
Redan 1785 bestämdes att vågen skulle fl: As early as 1785 it was decided that the weighing station would move to Pustervik, and a harbour measuring 180 by 30 metres was dug. But no one could agree on the fees, so the move didn't happen until 1802 or 1803. The weighing station operated there from 1806 to 1892.
Redan 1828 byggdes en klaffbro över sund: A bascule bridge was built across the strait as early as 1828. In the 1880s it was replaced by an opening wooden bridge, paid for by the banker André Oscar Wallenberg, who owned Malmvik. New bridges followed in 1930 and 1973.
Redan 1876 ritade stadsingenjören Hans W: As early as 1876, city engineer Hans Wilhelm Brandel drew up a grid of streets here, but nothing came of it. The square only took shape with Albert Lilienberg’s town plan of 1916. The wooden houses along Slottsskogsgatan were pulled down between 1917 and 1937 and replaced by landshövdingehus – Gothenburg’s typical tenements with a stone ground floor and wooden upper storeys.
Redan 1878 öppnades en hållplats här på: A halt opened here as early as 1878 on what was then the SWB railway. Several station buildings have stood east of the tracks; the last, from 1922, was pulled down in 1969. In 1963 a station building was put on the platform instead, reached through a pedestrian tunnel.
Redan 1904 fick en gata på Lundbyvassen: As early as 1904 a street on Lundbyvassen was named Tellusgatan, after our own planet. That street is long gone. Today's Tellusgatan got its name in 1965 and is lined with three-storey red-brick buildings from 1966.
Redan 1924 skenade en tom släpvagn nedfö: Back in 1924 an empty tram trailer ran away down this same street. A driver heading uphill reversed his tram at speed and managed to catch it, so only property was damaged. Ever since, tram couplings have always had an extra safety chain.
The tower was already out of use by 1926. The wells in the Järva ridge had been pumped so hard that brackish water from Brunnsviken seeped in, so Sundbyberg switched to water from Görväln on Lake Mälaren.
Redan 1930 gick spårvagnslinje 19, Örbyb: As early as 1930, tram route 19 – the Örby line – ran from Slussen to Örby, with a stop at Svedmyran. After 21 years it was replaced by the metro, and the stretch between Globen and Stureby follows the old tramway.
Redan 1933 föreslog tidningen Rörinstall: As early as 1933 the trade journal Rörinstallatören (The Plumber) suggested Sweden should have a museum of plumbing and heating. The idea didn't take shape until the 1980s, and in 1993 a small exhibition opened in the entrance of Katrineholm's technical college.
Redan 1942 beslöt LM Ericssons vd Hans T: As early as 1942, LM Ericsson's managing director Hans Theobald Holm decided to support a leisure centre near the factory, where employees and their families could socialise and educate themselves. Building had to wait until after the war, and the centre opened on 2 November 1946.
Redan 1975 sändes Eurovision Song Contes: As early as 1975 the Eurovision Song Contest was broadcast from Stockholmsmässan, the Stockholm International Fairs, and Melodifestivalen, Sweden’s Eurovision selection, was held here in 1996 and 1999. Since then the Kristallen TV awards, the Friday finals of Idol and Talang (Sweden’s Got Talent) have all been recorded here.

The Eurovision Song Contest was broadcast from here as early as 1975, and Melodifestivalen, Sweden's Eurovision selection, was held here in 1996 and 1999. Since then the TV awards Kristallen, Idol and Talang have all been recorded in the exhibition halls.
Redan 1988 föreslogs en företagspark här: A business park was proposed along the motorway here as early as 1988. The buildings were to have a "good shopfront position" facing the E4/E20 while also shielding the older houses of northern Segeltorp from the noise. Work on the street began in the late 1990s.
Redan 1999 ordnades Highvalley Classic &: Back in 1999 the Highvalley Classic & Festival was launched, a downhill competition with live music, held ten times until 2009. The idea for the park came from the Stockholm Sub Surfers association, and the first phase was built in 2011–2012 for about 30 million kronor.
Redan 2006 fanns planer på ett 70-våning: As early as 2006 there were plans for a 70-storey tower, Tell US Tower, designed by Gert Wingårdh. It was blocked partly because the county administrative board ruled in 2015 that buildings over 45 metres could interfere with the armed forces' technical systems. In 2018 came a final no, on the grounds of air traffic.
Redan första sommaren 1929 levererade In: In its very first summer, 1929, the Inverness spring delivered 700,000 bottles of water and soft drinks. The range included Vichy water, dry ginger ale, Sockerdricka lemonade and Grappo. Svenska Dagbladet praised the water for its "unusual purity".
Redan första sommaren 1929 levererade br: In its very first summer, 1929, the brewery delivered 700,000 bottles of water and soft drinks, including sockerdricka (a Swedish lemonade), Grappo and dry ginger ale. The founder, Torsten Ax:son Johnson, probably brought the recipe for club soda back from Ireland.
Redan i början av 1700-talet byggdes ett: As early as the beginning of the 18th century a first poorhouse was built here, on the initiative of Tumba paper mill, which wanted to look after its old workers. A map from 1712 shows a small poor cottage just west of today's building.
Redan i slutet av 1890-talet idrottade p: Boys from Södermalm were already doing sport by Källtorpssjön lake in the late 1890s. In the 1920s members of the Swedish Society for Nature Conservation wanted to turn the area into a people's park for Nacka, and in 1926 the botanist Rutger Sernander wrote that it had no equal anywhere around Stockholm.
Redan innan Stadion fanns idrottade stoc: Stockholmers were playing sport here long before the Olympic Stadium was built. Stockholms idrottspark opened in 1896 as the city's first civilian sports ground. It had a 400-metre concrete track for cycling and running and was demolished in 1910. Along Valhallavägen, in the Villastaden area, stand 1880s houses that carry the City Museum's highest heritage rating.
Redan på 1300-talet fanns Näsby slott vi: Näsby Castle stood by Näsbyviken bay as early as the 1300s. It got its present look in the 1600s to designs by Nicodemus Tessin the Elder, and several parks were planted around it. It's those palace parks that gave Näsbypark its name.
Redan på 1600-talet började Mölndal bli: Mölndal was already becoming an industrial town in the 1600s. Paper came first, followed by oil mills and textiles. The good water in the river gave the factories a head start.
Redan på 1620-talet lät Klas Horn bygga: As early as the 1620s Klas Horn built a three-storey stone castle about 60 metres north of today's main building. It's long gone, but an excavation in 1999 turned up fragments of wall, glass, porcelain and pottery.
Redan på 1750-talet bryggdes öl vid ån,: Beer was already being brewed by the river in the 1750s, on the spot where Johan Albrecht Pripp later ran his brewery right up until 1976. In the late 1700s a distillery was also set up here, drawing its water from the Fattighusån canal.
Redan på 1890-talet oroade man sig för t: People were already worrying about the square's nightlife in the 1890s. In 1897 the newspaper Morgonposten complained about the "rather outspoken company" who gathered here at weekends on their way to or from alcohol-fuelled entertainment.
Redan på 1920-talet fanns ett litet affä: Back in the 1920s there was already a small shopping centre here. It included the so-called 'horizontal skyscraper', a long, low timber building of one and a half storeys packed with shops and services.
Redan på 1920-talet fanns planer på att: There were plans to develop the land around Viksjö farm as early as the 1920s, but the farm lay far from the railway and the main roads. Only once cars became common did it pay off. That's why Viksjö is the only part of Järfälla that grew up independently of the Västerås railway line.
Redan på 1920-talet växte ett litet affä: A small shopping centre grew up here as early as the 1920s. It included the so-called 'horizontal skyscraper' – a long, low timber building of one and a half storeys filled with shops and services.
Redan på medeltiden var Utby en egen för: Utby was already a parish of its own in the Middle Ages. The old church is said to have been destroyed in 1566 by Danish troops under Daniel Rantzau, who were laying waste to this part of Västergötland at the time.
Redan på vikingatiden hade landhöjningen: By the Viking Age, land rise had already formed a narrow isthmus between Edsviken and Norrviken. Boats had to be unloaded there, or rolled over land on logs. That’s why Sollentuna’s coat of arms shows three red Viking ships standing on rollers.
Redan sommaren 1920, innan anläggningen: In the summer of 1920, before the studios were even finished, the first film was shot here: Victor Sjöström's The Phantom Carriage, with a graveyard built specially for it. But all the double exposures took time, so Mauritz Stiller's Erotikon reached cinemas first.
Redaren Jacob Gustaf Setterwall gjorde s: The shipowner Jacob Gustaf Setterwall did very well for himself, and in 1896 he built a grand villa in Finntorp that is now one of the oldest buildings in Nacka. A little further off, by the bay of Svindersviken, is Svindersvik, a mid-18th-century summer residence designed by Carl Hårleman for the merchant Claes Grill. It's considered one of the best-preserved Rococo estates in Sweden – partly because nobody has ever lived there all year round.
Redaren Jacob Gustaf Setterwall köpte 18: In 1871 the shipowner Jacob Gustaf Setterwall bought the land between the Kyrkviken and Svindersviken bays, and his first summer home was a small wooden villa in Swiss chalet style. Then the shipping line took off and things got grander: in 1896 the lavish Setterwall villa, designed by Johan Laurentz, was completed. On the Nysätra headland a little further on stood the Nackanäs inn, which welcomed guests right up until it burned down in 1960.
Redbergsplatsen hette förr Korsvägen och: Redbergsplatsen square was once called Korsvägen, 'the crossroads', and got its current name in 1883. In 1873 a public water pump was put up here, so that people could enjoy water from Lake Delsjön. Just north of the square, in Redbergslids Folkpark – a 'people's park' for popular entertainment – a pavilion with a stage for performers went up in 1886. And below Sankt Pauli kyrka, St Paul's Church, look out for the bronze fountain group Elementens kamp, the Struggle of the Elements, which was moved here from Olskrokstorget in 1968.
Reenstiernska palatset, även kallat Momm: The Reenstierna Palace, also known as Mommas hus, was built in the 1660s and still looks much as it did then. It's a fine example of the influence Dutch immigrants had on Stockholm's architecture. Right next door stood Södra barnbördshuset, the city's maternity hospital, and Maria Hospital, which opened in 1876. The hospital started out with 125 beds in an old 18th-century factory building, which has since been converted into flats and a nursery school.
Rekordet på Råsunda är 52 943 åskådare,: Råsunda's record is 52,943 spectators, set at the World Cup qualifier between Sweden and West Germany on 26 September 1965. For club sides, Djurgården hold the record, with 50,750 fans against IFK Göteborg in 1959.
Rekordet på Spånga IP är 3 057 åskådare,: The attendance record at Spånga IP is 3,057, set when Spånga IS played Hammarby in 1993. Djurgården's men's bandy team has also played here, as AIK did before them. The indoor football hall is popular with Stockholm clubs for winter training.
